```js
/* ============================================
   Behaviours (plan T2.3; spec §5.4, §6.3, §6.4, §6.6, §8 items 10–11, C-13)
   Every init is idempotent: site.js runs the page-independent ones itself at
   DOMContentLoaded, and a page enhancer may call any of them again safely.
   ============================================ */

const COVERED_STATES = { CA: 'California', FL: 'Florida', NY: 'New York', TX: 'Texas' };
const BREAKPOINTS = { narrow: '(min-width: 560px)', wide: '(min-width: 880px)' };
const HOME_KEY = 'cv-home';
const PARTY_KEY = 'cv-show-party';
const bound = new Set();

// Read once (§6.6): programmatic scrolls use behavior 'auto' when reduced motion is set.
const REDUCED_MOTION = (() => {
    try {
        return typeof window !== 'undefined' && !!window.matchMedia
            && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
    } catch (e) {
        return false;
    }
})();

function isWide() {
    try {
        return !!window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia(BREAKPOINTS.wide).matches;
    } catch (e) {
        return false;
    }
}

function once(name) {
    if (bound.has(name)) return false;
    bound.add(name);
    return true;
}

/* ---- Storage: every access in try/catch (private mode, blocked storage) ---- */
function storageGet(store, key) {
    try {
        return window[store].getItem(key);
    } catch (e) {
        return null;
    }
}

function storageSet(store, key, value) {
    try {
        window[store].setItem(key, value);
        return true;
    } catch (e) {
        return false;
    }
}

function storageRemove(store, key) {
    try {
        window[store].removeItem(key);
    } catch (e) {
        /* nothing stored, nothing to remove */
    }
}

/* ---- Focus (§8 item 11) ---- */
function focusHeading(heading) {
    if (!heading) return;
    if (!heading.hasAttribute('tabindex')) heading.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1');
    heading.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    heading.scrollIntoView({ block: 'start', behavior: REDUCED_MOTION ? 'auto' : 'smooth' });
}

function focusFirstControl(container) {
    if (!container) return;
    const target = container.querySelector('input, select, textarea, button, a[href], summary');
    if (target) target.focus();
}

/* ---- Remembered district: localStorage['cv-home'] (§5.4, C-13) ---- */
// {state, district, savedAt} or null. Only covered states and whole district numbers count.
function readHome() {
    let value = null;
    try {
        value = JSON.parse(storageGet('localStorage', HOME_KEY) || 'null');
    } catch (e) {
        return null;
    }
    if (!value || !COVERED_STATES[value.state]) return null;
    const district = Number(value.district);
    if (!Number.isInteger(district) || district < 1 || district > 99) return null;
    return { state: value.state, district, savedAt: String(value.savedAt || '') };
}

function todayIso() {
    const now = new Date();
    const pad = (n) => String(n).padStart(2, '0');
    return `${now.getFullYear()}-${pad(now.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(now.getDate())}`;
}

// Written only on the reader's own act: a #mine landing, the Remember button, or a
// bill-page ZIP pick (T7.3). Returns the stored object, or null when it was refused.
function rememberDistrict(state, district) {
    const code = String(state || '').toUpperCase();
    const number = Number(district);
    if (!COVERED_STATES[code] || !Number.isInteger(number) || number < 1 || number > 99) return null;
    const home = { state: code, district: number, savedAt: todayIso() };
    return storageSet('localStorage', HOME_KEY, JSON.stringify(home)) ? home : null;
}

function forgetHome() {
    storageRemove('localStorage', HOME_KEY);
}

function homePlace(home) {
    return `${COVERED_STATES[home.state]}, District ${home.district}`;
}

function homeHref(home) {
    return `/state?code=${home.state}&district=${home.district}`;
}

// "Remembered: New York, District 4 · Change · Forget" (§5.4). onForget(line) runs after
// the key is removed and returns the re-rendered container; focus goes to its first control.
function rememberedLine(home, onForget) {
    const forget = el('button', { type: 'button', className: 'btn--secondary remember-forget' }, t('forget'));
    const line = el('p', { className: 'meta remembered-line' },
        t('remembered', { place: homePlace(home) }), ' · ',
        el('a', { href: '/#find', className: 'remember-change' }, t('change')), ' · ',
        forget);
    forget.addEventListener('click', () => {
        forgetHome();
        rewriteMastheadLink();
        const container = typeof onForget === 'function' ? onForget(line) : null;
        if (container) focusFirstControl(container);
    });
    return line;
}

// The #mine fragment is the only automatic trigger (§3.3): write cv-home from the URL's own
// code and district, then drop the fragment with history.replaceState.
function initHome() {
    if (!once('home')) return readHome();
    if (window.location.hash === '#mine') {
        const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
        if (params.get('code') && params.get('district')) rememberDistrict(params.get('code'), params.get('district'));
        try {
            history.replaceState(history.state, '', window.location.pathname + window.location.search);
        } catch (e) {
            /* the fragment stays; nothing else depends on it */
        }
    }
    return readHome();
}

// Masthead "My representatives": server href is /#find; point it at the remembered district.
function rewriteMastheadLink() {
    const link = document.getElementById('nav-mine');
    if (!link) return;
    const home = readHome();
    link.setAttribute('href', home ? homeHref(home) : '/#find');
}

// The reveal lives in sessionStorage only; the old localStorage key is removed on every load.
function removeLegacyPartyKey() {
    storageRemove('localStorage', PARTY_KEY);
}

/* ---- Photos (§6.3): a failed <img> is removed so the initials block shows ---- */
function dropBrokenPhoto(img) {
    if (img && img.parentNode && img.parentNode.classList && img.parentNode.classList.contains('photo')) {
        img.parentNode.removeChild(img);
    }
}

function initPhotos() {
    if (once('photos')) {
        document.addEventListener('error', (event) => {
            if (event.target && event.target.tagName === 'IMG') dropBrokenPhoto(event.target);
        }, true);
    }
    // Images that failed before this script ran: complete, nothing decoded, a source chosen
    // (a lazy image not yet requested has currentSrc '' and is caught by the listener later).
    document.querySelectorAll('.photo img').forEach((img) => {
        if (img.complete && img.naturalWidth === 0 && img.currentSrc) dropBrokenPhoto(img);
    });
}

/* ---- Party toggle (§6.4, §4.2, §4.3, §5.4) ----
   One control pair, "Show party labels" / "Hide party labels" (the label is the state); the
   role=status sibling .party-status (present and empty in the HTML) announces the change.
   Accepted call shapes, so each page passes what it has:
     initPartyToggle()                         – fetch the toggle's data-party-url and fill spans
     initPartyToggle(fill)                     – fill(true|false) after the default fill/clear
     initPartyToggle(onShow, onHide)           – onShow(payload) / onHide()
     initPartyToggle({url, onShow, onHide})    – as above with an explicit ?show_party=true URL */
function initPartyToggle(arg, hideArg) {
    const toggles = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.party-toggle'));
    if (!toggles.length || !once('party')) return;
    let url = toggles[0].getAttribute('data-party-url') || '';
    let onShow = null;
    let onHide = null;
    if (typeof arg === 'function' && typeof hideArg === 'function') {
        onShow = arg;
        onHide = hideArg;
    } else if (typeof arg === 'function') {
        onShow = () => arg(true);
        onHide = () => arg(false);
    } else if (arg && typeof arg === 'object') {
        url = arg.url || url;
        onShow = typeof arg.onShow === 'function' ? arg.onShow : null;
        onHide = typeof arg.onHide === 'function' ? arg.onHide : null;
    }
    let revealed = false;
    let partyName = '';
    let payload = null;

    function status(key) {
        document.querySelectorAll('.party-status').forEach((node) => { node.textContent = key ? t(key) : ''; });
    }

    function label() {
        toggles.forEach((button) => { button.textContent = revealed ? t('hideParty') : t('showParty'); });
    }

    // Default fill from the payload: overview members by data-bioguide, the member header,
    // and "Voted for {Name}" into Speaker rows. Page callbacks may add to it.
    function fillSpeakerPicks() {
        const picks = (payload && payload.speaker_votes) || {};
        document.querySelectorAll('.speaker-pick[data-rc]').forEach((span) => {
            const name = revealed ? picks[span.getAttribute('data-rc')] : '';
            span.textContent = name ? `Voted for ${name}` : '';
        });
    }

    function fillSpans() {
        const byId = {};
        const members = payload ? [].concat(payload.senators || [], payload.house || [], payload.members || []) : [];
        members.forEach((member) => { if (member && member.bioguideId) byId[member.bioguideId] = member.partyName || ''; });
        document.querySelectorAll('[data-bioguide] .party').forEach((span) => {
            const holder = span.closest('[data-bioguide]');
            const value = holder ? byId[holder.getAttribute('data-bioguide')] : '';
            if (value !== undefined) span.textContent = revealed ? value : '';
        });
        partyName = payload && payload.member ? payload.member.partyName || '' : '';
        document.querySelectorAll('.member-header .party').forEach((span) => { span.textContent = revealed ? partyName : ''; });
        fillSpeakerPicks();
    }

    async function show(announce) {
        revealed = true;
        label();
        try {
            if (url && !payload) {
                const response = await fetch(url);
                if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`party ${response.status}`);
                payload = await response.json();
            }
            fillSpans();
            if (onShow) await onShow(payload);
            storageSet('sessionStorage', PARTY_KEY, '1');
            if (announce) status('partyShown');
        } catch (e) {
            // The reveal failed: put the "Show party labels" label back and say nothing.
            // "Party labels hidden" would be a false status after a Show press (§8 item 10),
            // and the spec gives no failure copy for this control.
            revealed = false;
            label();
            fillSpans();
            status('');
        }
    }

    function hide() {
        revealed = false;
        label();
        document.querySelectorAll('.party, .speaker-pick').forEach((span) => { span.textContent = ''; });
        if (onHide) onHide();
        storageRemove('sessionStorage', PARTY_KEY);
        status('partyHidden');
    }

    function onToggle() {
        if (revealed) hide();
        else show(true);
    }

    toggles.forEach((button) => button.addEventListener('click', onToggle));
    label();
    if (storageGet('sessionStorage', PARTY_KEY) === '1') show(false);
}

/* ---- Share (§4.3 Share, §6.4): navigator.share, else copy the canonical URL ---- */
function canonicalUrl() {
    const link = document.querySelector('link[rel="canonical"]');
    return link ? link.href : window.location.origin + window.location.pathname;
}

function copyText(text) {
    if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) return navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const field = el('textarea', { readonly: true, className: 'visually-hidden' });
        field.value = text;
        document.body.appendChild(field);
        field.select();
        const ok = document.execCommand && document.execCommand('copy');
        document.body.removeChild(field);
        if (ok) resolve();
        else reject(new Error('copy'));
    });
}

function initShare() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.share-btn, [data-share]').forEach((button) => {
        if (button.hasAttribute('data-share-bound')) return;
        button.setAttribute('data-share-bound', '');
        button.addEventListener('click', async () => {
            const data = {
                title: button.getAttribute('data-share-title') || document.title.split(' | ')[0],
                text: button.getAttribute('data-share-text') || '',
                url: button.getAttribute('data-share-url') || canonicalUrl(),
            };
            const statusNode = (button.parentNode && button.parentNode.querySelector('.share-status'))
                || document.querySelector('.share-status');
            if (navigator.share) {
                try {
                    await navigator.share(data);
                    return;
                } catch (e) {
                    if (e && e.name === 'AbortError') return;
                }
            }
            try {
                await copyText(data.url);
                if (statusNode) statusNode.textContent = t('linkCopied');
            } catch (e) {
                if (statusNode) statusNode.textContent = data.url;
            }
        });
    });
}

/* ---- Notify form (§4.1 m2): JSON POST, result in role=status, focus to it ---- */
function initNotify() {
    const form = document.getElementById('notify-form');
    if (!form || !once('notify')) return;
    const fields = form.querySelector('fieldset.notify-fields');
    if (fields) fields.disabled = false;
    const stateSelect = document.getElementById('notify-state');
    const email = document.getElementById('notify-email');
    const emailError = document.getElementById('notify-email-error');
    const submit = document.getElementById('notify-submit');
    const status = document.getElementById('notify-status');
    if (!stateSelect || !email || !status) return;

    function setEmailError(message) {
        if (!emailError) return;
        emailError.textContent = message;
        if (message) {
            email.setAttribute('aria-describedby', emailError.id);
            email.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true');
        } else {
            email.removeAttribute('aria-invalid');
        }
    }

    email.addEventListener('invalid', () => setEmailError(t('invalidEmail')));
    email.addEventListener('input', () => setEmailError(''));
    form.addEventListener('submit', async (event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        const state = stateSelect.value;
        const stateName = stateSelect.options[stateSelect.selectedIndex]
            ? stateSelect.options[stateSelect.selectedIndex].textContent.trim() : state;
        if (submit) submit.disabled = true;
        status.textContent = '';
        let ok = false;
        try {
            const response = await fetch('/api/notify', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify({ email: email.value.trim(), state }),
            });
            ok = response.ok;
        } catch (e) {
            ok = false;
        }
        status.textContent = ok ? t('notifyThanks', { state: stateName }) : t('notifyFailed');
        status.classList.toggle('field-error', !ok);
        if (ok) form.reset();
        if (submit) submit.disabled = false;
        if (!status.hasAttribute('tabindex')) status.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1');
        status.focus();
    });
}

/* ---- Page-independent start-up: run once per page, before page enhancers ---- */
function initSite() {
    removeLegacyPartyKey();
    initHome();
    rewriteMastheadLink();
    initPhotos();
    initNotify();
}

if (typeof document !== 'undefined') {
    if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initSite);
    else initSite();
}
```

```python
# --- Shell gates and the native feedback dialog (plan T2.4; spec §2.2 #2–#5, §6.4 dialog, §6.9 item 7) ---

SHELLS = sorted(STATIC.glob("*.html"))
DIALOG_IDS = ["feedback-modal", "feedback-open", "feedback-cancel", "feedback-overlay", "feedback-form",
              "feedback-message", "feedback-submit", "feedback-status", "feedback-context"]


def _tag(html: str, tag: str, element_id: str) -> str:
    match = re.search(rf"<{tag}\b[^>]*\bid=\"{element_id}\"[^>]*>", html)
    assert match, f"<{tag} id={element_id}> missing"
    return match.group(0)


def test_every_shell_keeps_title_head_and_no_inline_script():
    assert len(SHELLS) >= 6
    for shell in SHELLS:
        html = shell.read_text()
        assert re.search(r"<title>[^<]+</title>", html), shell.name
        assert "</head>" in html, shell.name
        assert re.search(r"<script(?![^>]*\bsrc=)[^>]*>", html) is None, shell.name
        assert re.search(r"\son[a-z]+\s*=", html, re.I) is None, shell.name


def test_every_shell_has_the_native_feedback_dialog():
    for shell in SHELLS:
        html = shell.read_text()
        for element_id in DIALOG_IDS:
            assert html.count(f'id="{element_id}"') == 1, f"{shell.name}: #{element_id}"
        dialog = _tag(html, "dialog", "feedback-modal")
        assert 'aria-labelledby="feedback-title"' in dialog and " hidden" not in dialog, shell.name
        assert re.search(r"<h2\b[^>]*\bid=\"feedback-title\"[^>]*>Send feedback</h2>", html), shell.name
        assert re.search(r"<label\b[^>]*\bfor=\"feedback-message\"[^>]*>What did you see\?</label>", html), shell.name
        assert "autofocus" in _tag(html, "textarea", "feedback-message"), shell.name
        status = _tag(html, "p", "feedback-status")
        assert 'role="status"' in status and " hidden" not in status, shell.name
        assert html[html.index(status) + len(status):].startswith("</p>"), f"{shell.name}: status not empty"
        assert '<div id="feedback-modal"' not in html, shell.name


def test_every_shell_has_an_empty_freshness_span_for_the_server():
    for shell in SHELLS:
        html = shell.read_text()
        assert html.count('<span id="data-freshness"></span>') == 1, shell.name
        assert re.search(r"·\s*<span id=\"data-freshness\">", html) is None, shell.name
```

- [ ] **Step 7: Rewrite `static/js/feedback.js`.** Replace the whole file (220 lines) with:

```js
/* Feedback dialog — native <dialog>, auto-captures page context
   (plan T2.4; spec §2.2 #5, §6.4 dialog, §10 #17). Hooks: #feedback-modal,
   #feedback-open, #feedback-cancel, #feedback-overlay, #feedback-form,
   #feedback-message, #feedback-submit, #feedback-status, #feedback-context,
   #about-feedback-cta, the h1 inside .member-header/.bill-header/.state-header,
   .state-header[data-context-label] (preferred on /state, T4.2) and any
   [data-feedback-open] button, including ones added later by JS (delegated). */

(function () {
    'use strict';

    var modal = document.getElementById('feedback-modal');
    var openBtn = document.getElementById('feedback-open');
    var cancelBtn = document.getElementById('feedback-cancel');
    var overlay = document.getElementById('feedback-overlay');
    var form = document.getElementById('feedback-form');
    var messageEl = document.getElementById('feedback-message');
    var submitBtn = document.getElementById('feedback-submit');
    var statusEl = document.getElementById('feedback-status');
    var contextEl = document.getElementById('feedback-context');

    var SENT = 'Thanks — sent.';
    var FAILED = "We couldn't send that. Please try again in a few minutes.";
    var opener = null;

    function getPageContext() {
        var path = window.location.pathname;
        var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);

        if (path === '/member') {
            var name = document.querySelector('.member-header h1');
            return {
                page_type: 'member',
                context_id: params.get('id') || '',
                context_label: name ? name.textContent.trim() : ''
            };
        }

        if (path === '/bill') {
            var title = document.querySelector('.bill-header h1');
            return {
                page_type: 'bill',
                context_id: params.get('type') && params.get('number')
                    ? params.get('type') + params.get('number')
                    : '',
                context_label: title ? title.textContent.trim() : ''
            };
        }

        if (path === '/state') {
            // T4.2 puts the place the page is about ("New York, District 4") on the header,
            // because the h1 there reads "New York's representatives"; old shells use the h1.
            var labelled = document.querySelector('.state-header[data-context-label]');
            var stateTitle = document.querySelector('.state-header h1');
            return {
                page_type: 'state',
                context_id: params.get('code') || '',
                context_label: labelled
                    ? labelled.getAttribute('data-context-label')
                    : (stateTitle ? stateTitle.textContent.trim() : '')
            };
        }

        if (path === '/about') {
            return { page_type: 'about', context_id: '', context_label: '' };
        }

        return { page_type: 'home', context_id: '', context_label: '' };
    }

    function setStatus(text, failed) {
        statusEl.textContent = text;
        statusEl.classList.toggle('field-error', !!failed);
    }

    function openModal(trigger) {
        if (!modal || typeof modal.showModal !== 'function') return;
        opener = trigger || document.activeElement;
        var ctx = getPageContext();
        if (ctx.context_label) {
            contextEl.textContent = 'About: ' + ctx.context_label;
            contextEl.hidden = false;
        } else {
            contextEl.textContent = '';
            contextEl.hidden = true;
        }
        setStatus('', false);
        submitBtn.disabled = false;
        if (!modal.open) modal.showModal();
        messageEl.focus();
    }

    function closeModal() {
        if (modal && modal.open) modal.close();
    }

    var hamburger = document.querySelector('.hamburger');
    var nav = document.querySelector('nav');
    if (hamburger && nav) {
        hamburger.addEventListener('click', function () {
            nav.classList.toggle('open');
            hamburger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', nav.classList.contains('open'));
        });

        // Close mobile menu when a nav link is clicked
        nav.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(function (link) {
            link.addEventListener('click', function () {
                nav.classList.remove('open');
                hamburger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
            });
        });

        // Close mobile menu on Escape key
        document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
            if (e.key === 'Escape' && nav.classList.contains('open')) {
                nav.classList.remove('open');
                hamburger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
            }
        });
    }

    // Set active nav link based on current path
    var currentPath = window.location.pathname;
    if (nav) {
        nav.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(function (link) {
            link.classList.remove('active');
            var href = link.getAttribute('href');
            if (currentPath === '/' && (href === '/' || href === '')) {
                link.classList.add('active');
            } else if (currentPath === '/about' && href === '/about') {
                link.classList.add('active');
            } else if (currentPath === '/member' && href === '/') {
                // No active state on detail pages
            } else if (currentPath === '/bill' && href === '/#browse') {
                link.classList.add('active');
            }
        });
    }

    if (!modal || !form) return;

    // Openers: the footer "Report an error on this page" (#feedback-open) and, at ≥880,
    // the fixed .feedback-btn. On the old shells they are the same element.
    var openers = [];
    if (openBtn) openers.push(openBtn);
    document.querySelectorAll('.feedback-btn').forEach(function (btn) {
        if (openers.indexOf(btn) === -1) openers.push(btn);
    });
    openers.forEach(function (btn) {
        btn.addEventListener('click', function () { openModal(btn); });
    });
    // Delegated opener for [data-feedback-open] buttons, including ones JS adds later
    // (the home vacancy row, T4.2 app.js); the trigger is the opener, so focus returns to it.
    document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        var trigger = e.target.closest && e.target.closest('[data-feedback-open]');
        if (trigger) openModal(trigger);
    });

    var aboutCta = document.getElementById('about-feedback-cta');
    if (aboutCta) {
        aboutCta.addEventListener('click', function () { openModal(aboutCta); });
    }

    if (cancelBtn) cancelBtn.addEventListener('click', closeModal);
    if (overlay) overlay.addEventListener('click', closeModal);
    // No backdrop-click close (§6.4 asks for Esc and Cancel only): a click on the
    // dialog's own padding also has e.target === modal and would throw away a
    // half-typed report.

    // Esc (the native cancel) and every close() end here: focus goes back to the opener.
    modal.addEventListener('close', function () {
        setStatus('', false);
        submitBtn.disabled = false;
        if (opener && document.body.contains(opener) && typeof opener.focus === 'function') {
            opener.focus();
        }
        opener = null;
    });

    form.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();

        var message = messageEl.value.trim();
        if (!message) return;

        var ctx = getPageContext();
        submitBtn.disabled = true;
        setStatus('', false);

        fetch('/api/feedback', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            body: JSON.stringify({
                message: message,
                page_url: window.location.href,
                page_type: ctx.page_type,
                context_id: ctx.context_id,
                context_label: ctx.context_label
            })
        })
        .then(function (res) {
            if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Failed');
            // Success stays in the dialog until the reader closes it (§6.4).
            messageEl.value = '';
            setStatus(SENT, false);
            submitBtn.disabled = false;
        })
        .catch(function () {
            setStatus(FAILED, true);
            submitBtn.disabled = false;
        });
    });
})();
```

- [ ] **Step 8: Fill `#data-freshness` on the server.** In `app/main.py`, directly above `def _serve_html`, add:

```python
_freshness_re = re.compile(r'<span id="data-freshness">\s*</span>')


def _freshness_text() -> str:
    """Footer freshness (spec §6.4 footer, §7.4): " · Synced September 5, 2026", or "" when
    last_sync is absent. The separator is inside the span so nothing dangles; no JS writes it."""
    from app.dependencies import get_data_service
    from app.render import format_date
    last_sync = get_data_service().get_sync_metadata().get("last_sync")
    if not last_sync:
        return ""
    try:
        formatted = format_date(str(last_sync)[:10])
    except (TypeError, ValueError, IndexError):
        return ""
    return f" · Synced {escape(formatted)}" if formatted else ""


def _fill_freshness(html: str) -> str:
    return _freshness_re.sub(
        lambda _match: f'<span id="data-freshness">{_freshness_text()}</span>', html, count=1)
```

  - `main._serve_html(filename: str, meta: dict | None = None, content_html: str | None = None, status_code: int = 200) -> HTMLResponse` — replaces a literal `<!--edition-->` (first occurrence) with the edition line and a literal `<!--content-->` (first occurrence) with `content_html`, content last; shells without markers are byte-for-byte unchanged apart from what they got before.
  - `DataService.earliest_roll_call_date() -> str | None` — the oldest ISO roll-call date in the index, computed once (the "since January 2021" of the home coverage sentence and the Record stamp); `None` without the index.
  - `main._edition_html() -> str` — reads `latest_roll_call_date()`; one code path for the newest date (T1.10's).
  - `main._page_content(build: Callable[[], str], meta: dict) -> tuple[str, int]` — `(html, 200)` or, when `build()` raises, `(render.render_error(h1), 503)` where `h1 = meta.get("h1") or meta["title"].split(" | ")[0]`.
  - `render.ELECTION_DAY: date` (2026-11-03), `render.COVERED_STATES: tuple[tuple[str, str], ...]` (CA, FL, NY, TX in that order), `render.NOTIFY_STATES: dict[str, str]` (the 46 uncovered states + DC, code → name, alphabetical by name; T3.3's `notify.py` validates against it), `render.ZIP_INPUT_PATTERN: str`, `render.PAGE_ERROR_SENTENCE: str`.
  - `render.render_edition(last_sync: str | None, latest_roll_call: str | None, now: datetime) -> str`
  - `render.render_error(h1: str) -> str`
  - `render.render_zip_form(compact: bool = False, value: str = "", error: str | None = None, form_id: str = "find", label: str = "Where do you live?") -> str` — input id is `zip` when `form_id == "find"`, else `{form_id}-field`; error id `{input id}-error`.
  - `render.render_state_links(counts: dict[str, int]) -> str` — `<ul class="state-links">` of four `a.state-link` chips.
  - `render.render_notify_disclosure() -> str` — markup contract consumed by `site.js initNotify` (T2.3): `form#notify-form.notify` (no `action`/`method`), `fieldset.notify-fields[disabled]` (site.js sets `disabled = false`), `select#notify-state[name=state][required]`, `input#notify-email[name=email][type=email]`, `p#notify-email-error.field-error` (present, empty), `button#notify-submit`, `p#notify-status[role=status][tabindex=-1]` (present, empty).

**Resolves:** spec §7.4 (edition line, America/Los_Angeles countdown, Nov 2–4 tests), §9.1 (`<!--content-->` marker, content injected after meta, `h()` escaping), §4 common (error state copy, `meta['h1']`), §3.2 (ZIP form attributes and pattern), §4.1 m2 (notify disclosure: uncovered-states select, privacy line, no-JS copy). Findings F40 (dated edition line, no "Updated weekly"), F41 (election date in the edition line), F19 (server-rendered first blocks), F21 (ZIP form markup ready for the first screen).

   ```python
   # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   # Shared page blocks (plan T3.1). Pure functions: every data value goes through
   # h(); hrefs use only fixed state codes. Constant copy that contains an
   # apostrophe is written literally (h() would turn ' into &#x27;).
   # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

   # Same date as data/synced/senate_2026.json "election_day" (a test asserts it).
   ELECTION_DAY = date(2026, 11, 3)

   COVERED_STATES = (("CA", "California"), ("FL", "Florida"), ("NY", "New York"), ("TX", "Texas"))

   # The notify form's only options: the 46 states ClearVoting does not cover, plus DC.
   NOTIFY_STATES = {
       "AL": "Alabama", "AK": "Alaska", "AZ": "Arizona", "AR": "Arkansas", "CO": "Colorado",
       "CT": "Connecticut", "DE": "Delaware", "DC": "District of Columbia", "GA": "Georgia",
       "HI": "Hawaii", "ID": "Idaho", "IL": "Illinois", "IN": "Indiana", "IA": "Iowa",
       "KS": "Kansas", "KY": "Kentucky", "LA": "Louisiana", "ME": "Maine", "MD": "Maryland",
       "MA": "Massachusetts", "MI": "Michigan", "MN": "Minnesota", "MS": "Mississippi",
       "MO": "Missouri", "MT": "Montana", "NE": "Nebraska", "NV": "Nevada", "NH": "New Hampshire",
       "NJ": "New Jersey", "NM": "New Mexico", "NC": "North Carolina", "ND": "North Dakota",
       "OH": "Ohio", "OK": "Oklahoma", "OR": "Oregon", "PA": "Pennsylvania", "RI": "Rhode Island",
       "SC": "South Carolina", "SD": "South Dakota", "TN": "Tennessee", "UT": "Utah",
       "VT": "Vermont", "VA": "Virginia", "WA": "Washington", "WV": "West Virginia",
       "WI": "Wisconsin", "WY": "Wyoming",
   }

   # Spec §3.2: the browser check mirrors the server rule ^\s*(\d{5})(?:[-\s]?\d{4})?\s*$.
   ZIP_INPUT_PATTERN = r"\s*[0-9]{5}([\-\s]?[0-9]{4})?\s*"

   PAGE_ERROR_SENTENCE = (
       "We couldn't load this page right now. Please try again in a moment, "
       "or use <em>Report an error</em> below to tell us."
   )


   def _pacific_today(now: datetime) -> date:
       """Today's date in America/Los_Angeles, so "Election Day is today" lasts until
       California polls close (spec §7.4). Falls back to the US DST rule when the host
       has no tz database (python:3.12-slim may ship without one; no new dependency)."""
       if now.tzinfo is None:
           now = now.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
       try:
           return now.astimezone(ZoneInfo("America/Los_Angeles")).date()
       except ZoneInfoNotFoundError:
           utc = now.astimezone(timezone.utc)
           # PDT runs from the second Sunday in March, 10:00 UTC, to the first Sunday in November, 09:00 UTC.
           march_8 = datetime(utc.year, 3, 8, 10, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
           dst_start = march_8 + timedelta(days=(6 - march_8.weekday()) % 7)
           nov_1 = datetime(utc.year, 11, 1, 9, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
           dst_end = nov_1 + timedelta(days=(6 - nov_1.weekday()) % 7)
           offset = -7 if dst_start <= utc < dst_end else -8
           return (utc + timedelta(hours=offset)).date()


   def render_edition(last_sync: str | None, latest_roll_call: str | None, now: datetime) -> str:
       """The one-line edition under the masthead nav (spec §7.4, §6.4)."""
       parts: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
       if last_sync:
           parts.append(("", f"Data synced {format_date(last_sync[:10])}"))
       if latest_roll_call:
           month_day = format_date(latest_roll_call[:10]).rsplit(",", 1)[0]
           parts.append(("edition-mid", f"Latest roll call {month_day}"))
       days = (ELECTION_DAY - _pacific_today(now)).days
       if days == 0:
           parts.append(("", "Election Day is today"))
       elif days > 0:
           weekday = ELECTION_DAY.strftime("%A")
           month_day = format_date(ELECTION_DAY.isoformat()).rsplit(",", 1)[0]
           unit = "day" if days == 1 else "days"
           parts.append(("", f"Election Day is {weekday}, {month_day} — {days} {unit} away"))
       if not parts:
           return ""
       spans = []
       for i, (cls, text) in enumerate(parts):
           class_attr = f' class="{cls}"' if cls else ""
           separator = " · " if i else ""
           spans.append(f"<span{class_attr}>{h(separator + text)}</span>")
       return f'<p class="edition">{"".join(spans)}</p>'
   ```

5. [ ] **Implement the error state and the three shared blocks in `app/render.py`** (append after `render_edition`):
   ```python
   def render_error(h1: str) -> str:
       """Spec §4 common: shown when the server cannot render a page's content."""
       return f'<section class="page-error"><h1>{h(h1)}</h1><p class="deck">{PAGE_ERROR_SENTENCE}</p></section>'


   def render_zip_form(compact: bool = False, value: str = "", error: str | None = None,
                       form_id: str = "find", label: str = "Where do you live?") -> str:
       """The ZIP finder (spec §3.2). A plain GET to /state that JavaScript never intercepts."""
       input_id = "zip" if form_id == "find" else f"{form_id}-field"
       error_id = f"{input_id}-error"
       form_class = "zip-form zip-form--compact" if compact else "zip-form"
       value_attr = f' value="{h(value)}"' if value else ""
       described = f' aria-describedby="{h(error_id)}" aria-invalid="true"' if error else ""
       error_html = f'<p class="field-error" id="{h(error_id)}">{h(error)}</p>' if error else ""
       return (
           f'<form class="{form_class}" id="{h(form_id)}" method="get" action="/state">'
           f'<label class="zip-label" for="{h(input_id)}">{h(label)}</label>'
           '<div class="zip-row">'
           f'<input id="{h(input_id)}" name="zip" type="text" inputmode="numeric" autocomplete="postal-code" '
           f'maxlength="10" pattern="{h(ZIP_INPUT_PATTERN)}" required{value_attr}{described}>'
           '<button class="btn" type="submit">Find my representatives</button>'
           "</div>"
           f"{error_html}</form>"
       )


   def render_state_links(counts: dict) -> str:
       """Four 44px state chips with real member counts ("New York · 28")."""
       items = []
       for code, name in COVERED_STATES:
           count = counts.get(code)
           label = f"{name} · {int(count)}" if count else name
           items.append(f'<li><a class="state-link" href="/state?code={code}">{h(label)}</a></li>')
       return f'<ul class="state-links">{"".join(items)}</ul>'


   def render_notify_disclosure() -> str:
       """"Somewhere else?" (spec §4.1 m2). No action/method, and the fields start disabled,
       so without JavaScript nothing can be typed or submitted (an email must never end up in
       a GET query string); site.js initNotify enables the fieldset and POSTs JSON."""
       options = "".join(f'<option value="{code}">{h(name)}</option>' for code, name in NOTIFY_STATES.items())
       return (
           '<details class="notify-disclosure">'
           "<summary>Somewhere else?</summary>"
           '<form class="notify" id="notify-form">'
           '<fieldset class="notify-fields" disabled>'
   ```

   ```python
   def _page_content(build, meta: dict) -> tuple[str, int]:
       """Run a page's server renderer. If the data is missing at request time, log it and
       return the spec §4 error state with 503, which the cache rules treat as no-store."""
       try:
           return build(), 200
       except Exception:

           return render.render_error(h1), 503
   ```

### Task T3.2: Home block renderers: lead, Latest Vote card, the Record

**Files:**
- Modify: `app/render.py` — append a section "Home blocks" after the T3.1 "Shared page blocks" section.
- Create: `tests/test_home_render.py`
- Modify: `tests/test_render_escaping.py` — append one self-contained `HOME_BLOCKS` dict and its parametrized test after the T3.1 block (reusing T1.3's `HOSTILE`/`assert_escaped`; T3.1 added `from app import render`).

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes:
  - `render.h`, `render.format_date(value, short=False)`, `render.format_bill_code(bill_type: str, number) -> str` ("H.R. 4795"), `render.ordinal(n: int) -> str` ("119th") (T1.3).
  - `render.render_zip_form`, `render.render_state_links`, `render.render_notify_disclosure` (T3.1).
  - `get_latest_vote()` payload (T1.9): `{"chamber": "House"|"Senate", "date": display str ("September 3, 2026", render.format_date long form, kept for the old app.js), "date_iso": ISO str, "plain_question": str, "result": str, "counts": {"yeas", "nays", "present", "absent"}, "bill": {"congress": int, "type": str, "number": int, "title": str}, "one_liner": str | None, "has_summary": bool, "outcome": str, "seal": str (same value as `outcome`), "state_tallies": {...}, "covered": ...}`. This task reads `outcome` as the §7.2 seal text for that roll call ("Passed the House 237–169"), which is how §4.1 m3 shows it ("the outcome as a status seal"); `None` when the index is unavailable. T1.2's `result_phrase` returns "Adopted by the {chamber} …" for joint and concurrent resolutions as well as simple ones, so the card takes the seal variant from `bill.type`, not from the text: filled `final` only for an `hres`/`sres` adoption (the one chamber is the only one needed, §6.4/§7.2), `moving` for everything else a single roll call can say.
  - `get_bills(limit=7)["bills"]` and `get_bills(summarized_only=True, limit=1)["bills"]` rows (T1.9): bills.json fields plus `one_liner` (null unless the summary is displayable, i.e. present and not `needs_review`), `provisions`, `derived_status` (T1.2's `render.bill_status` result for the row, always `{"text", "variant"}`; `_status_parts` trusts its variant and keeps a text-prefix guess only for a bare string, where "Adopted by the …" is never guessed final) and `activity_date` (ISO; falls back to `latestAction.actionDate`).
  - T2.1 classes reused as they are: `.row-headline--official` (the Lora 500 two-line-clamped row title; G6 uses the same class), `.official`, `.clamp2`, `.provisions li`, `.arrow-link`, `.bill-row`, `.row-meta`, `.tally*`, `.seal*`, `.vote-card`, `.state-links`.
- Produces:
  - `render.render_seal(text: str, variant: str) -> str` — `<span class="seal seal--{final|moving|pending|ballot}">`; unknown variants render as `moving`.
  - `render.render_tally(counts: dict, label: str) -> str` — `.tally` wrapper: `div.tally-track[role=img][aria-label="{label}: N voted yes, N voted no[, N did not vote]"]` with `span.tally-seg.tally-seg--yes[style=width][data-yes]` and `span.tally-seg.tally-seg--no[style=width][data-no]`, then sibling `p.tally-text` "237 yes · 169 no" (+ " · 27 didn't vote" in `.meta` when non-zero).
  - `render.render_home_lead(counts: dict, coverage: dict) -> str` — `div.lead-main` (kicker, h1, deck, finder, state chips, coverage, notify disclosure; nothing else); `coverage = {"members": int, "since": ISO str | None}`.
  - Home module-4 mount (for T4.2): `<div class="home-reps" id="home-reps"></div>`, empty, rendered by `render_home` directly after `</section>` of `section.lead` and before the Record — below the finder (the fold never moves, §9.6) and after the Latest Vote card, so the outline is h1 → "The latest vote" → "Your representatives" → "What Congress voted on" (§8 item 2, §4.1 module order m3 then m4).
  - `render.render_latest_vote_card(vote: dict | None, ai_updated: str | None = None) -> str` — `aside.vote-card[data-ssr="1"][aria-labelledby="latest-vote-h"]` with `h2.kicker#latest-vote-h` "The latest vote".
  - `render.render_record(bills: list | None, last_sync: str | None, since: str | None = None, latest_summarized: dict | None = None, ai_updated: str | None = None) -> str` — `section.record#record[data-ssr="1"]`.
  - `render.render_home(counts, coverage, vote, bills, latest_summarized, last_sync, ai_updated) -> str` — `section.lead` (lead-main + card; no `aria-label`, so it is not a region landmark and the spec's `aside.vote-card` sits one landmark deep, inside `main` only), then `#home-reps`, then the Record. Known axe finding, recorded here so no one "fixes" it ad hoc: a named `aside` inside `main` still trips the rule `landmark-complementary-is-top-level`; T9.1 step 4 settles it for every page before the gate runs (it turns the card into `<section class="vote-card">`, keeping class, id and `aria-labelledby`), so this group ships the spec's §4.1 markup as written.
  - `render.SUMMARY_ATTRIBUTION: str`.

**Resolves:** spec §4.1 (modules 2, 3, 5 and states), §6.4 (tally bar, status seal, bill row), §8 item 2 (home heading outline; the card's "The latest vote" is an `<h2 class="kicker">`, one markup for §4.1 m3 and §8 item 2 — completeness residual 4), §2.3 C-11 (the card degrades by content at the same size), §7.6 (AI attribution only where AI text rendered). Findings F01 (newest bills by activity regardless of summary; the stamp counts unsummarized rows), F02 (structured card with conditional link text and the pending seal), F17 (no sentence template), F37 (no official titles on summarized rows; 140-character cap with "Show full title"), F21 (ZIP form is the lead's first control).

4. [ ] **Add the private helpers to `app/render.py`** (new section after "Shared page blocks"; add `from urllib.parse import quote` and `import re` to the top import block if T1.3 did not):
   ```python
   # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   # Home blocks (plan T3.2, spec §4.1): lead, Latest Vote card, the Record.
   # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

   SUMMARY_ATTRIBUTION = "Summarized by AI from the bill's title, official summary and text excerpt"
   _SEAL_VARIANTS = ("final", "moving", "pending", "ballot")
   # Only texts that are final whatever the bill type. "Adopted by the …" is final only for
   # hres/sres, which the text alone cannot tell (T1.2 bill_status decides it from the type).
   _FINAL_SEAL_PREFIXES = ("Became law", "Passed both chambers")
   _SIMPLE_RESOLUTIONS = ("hres", "sres")
   _PENDING_SEAL_TEXT = "No plain-English summary yet"


   def _record_href(congress, bill_type, number) -> str:
       """Bill URL from validated parts only (spec §3.3 canonical form, lowercase type)."""
       return f"/bill?congress={int(congress)}&type={quote(str(bill_type).lower(), safe='')}&number={int(number)}"


   def _cap(text: str, limit: int) -> tuple[str, bool]:
       """Cap official text on a word boundary with an ellipsis; returns (text, was_capped)."""
       text = " ".join((text or "").split())
       if len(text) <= limit:
           return text, False
       head = text[: limit + 1]
       cut = head.rsplit(" ", 1)[0] if " " in head else text[:limit]
       return cut.rstrip(" ,;:") + "…", True


   def _status_parts(status) -> tuple[str, str]:
       """A bill's derived_status -> (seal text, variant). T1.2's bill_status always returns
       {"text", "variant"}, and its variant is trusted (anything else reads as moving). The
       text-prefix guess is only for a bare string."""
       if isinstance(status, dict):
           text = status.get("text") or "No final vote yet"
           variant = status.get("variant")
           return text, variant if variant in ("final", "moving") else "moving"
       text = status or "No final vote yet"
       return text, "final" if text.startswith(_FINAL_SEAL_PREFIXES) else "moving"


   def _activity_date(bill: dict) -> str:
       return bill.get("activity_date") or (bill.get("latestAction") or {}).get("actionDate") or ""


   def _bill_code(bill: dict) -> str:
       return format_bill_code(str(bill.get("type", "")).lower(), bill.get("number"))


   def _month_year(iso: str) -> str:
       long_form = format_date(iso[:10])  # "January 3, 2021"
       return f"{long_form.split(' ', 1)[0]} {long_form.rsplit(' ', 1)[1]}"


   def _ai_line(ai_updated: str | None) -> str:
       dated = f" · summaries last updated {h(format_date(ai_updated[:10]))}" if ai_updated else ""
       return f'<p class="meta ai-line">{SUMMARY_ATTRIBUTION}{dated}</p>'


   def _provisions(provisions) -> str:
       items = "".join(f"<li>{h(p)}</li>" for p in (provisions or [])[:4])
       return f'<ul class="provisions">{items}</ul>' if items else ""


   def _full_title(title: str) -> str:
       return f'<details class="full-title"><summary>Show full title</summary><p>{h(title)}</p></details>'


   def _tally_label(seal_text: str, chamber: str) -> str:
       """"Passed the House 237–169" -> "Passed the House" for the tally's aria-label."""
       label = re.sub(r"\s*\d+[–-]\d+.*$", "", seal_text or "").strip()
       return label or (f"{chamber} vote" if chamber else "Vote")
   ```

5. [ ] **Add `render_seal` and `render_tally`:**
   ```python
   def render_seal(text: str, variant: str) -> str:
       """Status seal (spec §6.4). Variants: final, moving, pending, ballot."""
       if variant not in _SEAL_VARIANTS:
           variant = "moving"
       return f'<span class="seal seal--{variant}">{h(text)}</span>'


   def render_tally(counts: dict, label: str) -> str:
       """Tally bar (spec §6.4): a role=img track with a spoken summary, and the visible
       numbers in a sibling paragraph. Segment widths are server style= (style-src allows it)."""
       yeas = int(counts.get("yeas") or 0)
       nays = int(counts.get("nays") or 0)
       absent = int(counts.get("absent") or 0)
       total = yeas + nays
       yes_pct = round(yeas * 100 / total, 1) if total else 0
       no_pct = round(100 - yes_pct, 1) if total else 0
       spoken = f"{label}: {yeas} voted yes, {nays} voted no" + (f", {absent} did not vote" if absent else "")
       didnt = f'<span class="meta"> · {absent} didn\'t vote</span>' if absent else ""
       return (
           '<div class="tally">'
           f'<div class="tally-track" role="img" aria-label="{h(spoken)}">'
           f'<span class="tally-seg tally-seg--yes" style="width:{yes_pct}%" data-yes="{yeas}"></span>'
           f'<span class="tally-seg tally-seg--no" style="width:{no_pct}%" data-no="{nays}"></span>'
           "</div>"
           f'<p class="tally-text"><span class="tally-yes">{yeas}</span> yes · '
           f'<span class="tally-no">{nays}</span> no{didnt}</p>'
           "</div>"
       )
   ```

6. [ ] **Add `render_latest_vote_card`:**
   ```python
   def render_latest_vote_card(vote: dict | None, ai_updated: str | None = None) -> str:
       """The Latest Vote (spec §4.1 m3): a structured card, never a sentence template.
       'The latest vote' is an h2 styled as a kicker (§8 item 2). Without data the card
       keeps its place and says so (C-11)."""
       heading = '<h2 class="kicker" id="latest-vote-h">The latest vote</h2>'
       if not vote or not vote.get("bill"):
           return (
               '<aside class="vote-card vote-card--empty" aria-labelledby="latest-vote-h" data-ssr="1">'
               f"{heading}<p class=\"deck\">The latest vote isn't available right now.</p></aside>"
           )
       bill = vote["bill"]
       href = _record_href(bill["congress"], bill["type"], bill["number"])
       chamber = vote.get("chamber") or ""
       dateline = " · ".join(part for part in (
           f"U.S. {chamber}" if chamber else "",
           format_date(vote["date_iso"]) if vote.get("date_iso") else "",
           vote.get("plain_question") or "",
       ) if part)
       if vote.get("has_summary") and vote.get("one_liner"):
           headline = f'<p class="card-headline">{h(vote["one_liner"])}</p>'
           link_text = "What this bill does, in plain English →"
           attribution = _ai_line(ai_updated)
       else:
           title = bill.get("title") or format_bill_code(str(bill["type"]).lower(), bill["number"])
           headline = (f'<p class="card-headline official clamp2">{h(title)}</p>'
                       f'<p class="card-seal">{render_seal(_PENDING_SEAL_TEXT, "pending")}</p>')
           link_text = "See the vote and the official summary →"
           attribution = ""
       seal_text = vote.get("outcome") or ""
       # One roll call's outcome is final only for a simple resolution's adoption (§6.4/§7.2);
       # result_phrase also says "Adopted by the …" for joint and concurrent resolutions.
       simple = str(bill.get("type", "")).lower() in _SIMPLE_RESOLUTIONS
       variant = "final" if simple and seal_text.startswith("Adopted by the") else "moving"
       seal = f'<p class="card-seal">{render_seal(seal_text, variant)}</p>' if seal_text else ""
       return (
           '<aside class="vote-card" aria-labelledby="latest-vote-h" data-ssr="1">'
           f"{heading}"
           f'<p class="dateline meta">{h(dateline)}</p>'
           f"{headline}"
           f"{render_tally(vote.get('counts') or {}, _tally_label(seal_text, chamber))}"
           f"{seal}"
           f'<a class="arrow-link" href="{h(href)}">{link_text}</a>'
           f"{attribution}"
           "</aside>"
       )
   ```

8. [ ] **Add `render_record`, its row builders and `render_home`:**
   ```python
   def _record_lead(bill: dict) -> str:
       href = _record_href(bill["congress"], bill["type"], bill["number"])
       code = _bill_code(bill)
       seal_text, variant = _status_parts(bill.get("derived_status"))
       date = _activity_date(bill)
       date_html = f' <span class="meta">{h(format_date(date[:10], short=True))}</span>' if date else ""
       title = bill.get("title") or code
       parts = [
           f'<p class="kicker">{h(code)} · {h(ordinal(int(bill["congress"])))} Congress</p>',
           f'<p class="row-meta">{render_seal(seal_text, variant)}{date_html}</p>',
       ]
       if bill.get("one_liner"):
           official, capped = _cap(title, 140)
           parts += [
               f'<p class="lead-headline"><a href="{h(href)}">{h(bill["one_liner"])}</a></p>',
               _provisions(bill.get("provisions")),
               f'<p class="official-line">Officially: {h(official)}</p>',
               _full_title(title) if capped else "",
               f'<a class="arrow-link" href="{h(href)}">See who voted →</a>',
           ]
       else:
           headline, capped = _cap(title, 140)
           parts += [
               f'<p class="lead-headline official"><a href="{h(href)}">{h(headline)}</a></p>',
               _full_title(title) if capped else "",
               f"<p>{render_seal(_PENDING_SEAL_TEXT, 'pending')}</p>",
           ]
       return f'<article class="record-lead">{"".join(parts)}</article>'


   def _record_row(bill: dict) -> str:
       href = _record_href(bill["congress"], bill["type"], bill["number"])
       code = _bill_code(bill)
       seal_text, variant = _status_parts(bill.get("derived_status"))
       date = _activity_date(bill)
       date_html = f'<span class="meta">{h(format_date(date[:10], short=True))}</span>' if date else ""
       if bill.get("one_liner"):
           headline = f'<span class="row-headline">{h(bill["one_liner"])}</span>'
       else:
           headline = (f'<span class="row-headline row-headline--official">{h(bill.get("title") or code)}</span>'
                       f'<span class="row-seal">{render_seal(_PENDING_SEAL_TEXT, "pending")}</span>')
       return (
           f'<li><a class="bill-row" href="{h(href)}">'
           f'<span class="row-meta"><span class="kicker">{h(code)}</span>'
           f"{render_seal(seal_text, variant)}{date_html}</span>"
           f"{headline}</a></li>"
       )


   def _latest_summary_block(bill: dict) -> str:
       href = _record_href(bill["congress"], bill["type"], bill["number"])
       date = _activity_date(bill)
       heading = "Most recent plain-English summary" + (f" · {format_date(date[:10], short=True)}" if date else "")
       return (
           '<section class="latest-summary" aria-labelledby="latest-summary-h">'
           f'<h2 id="latest-summary-h">{h(heading)}</h2>'
           f'<p class="kicker">{h(_bill_code(bill))}</p>'
           f'<p class="lead-headline"><a href="{h(href)}">{h(bill["one_liner"])}</a></p>'
           f"{_provisions(bill.get('provisions'))}"
           f'<a class="arrow-link" href="{h(href)}">See who voted →</a>'
           "</section>"
       )


   def render_record(bills: list | None, last_sync: str | None, since: str | None = None,
                     latest_summary: dict | None = None, ai_updated: str | None = None) -> str:
       """The Record (spec §4.1 m5): the seven newest bills by activity date, regardless
       of summary; the stamp counts the rows that show an official title."""
       opening = '<section class="record" id="record" aria-labelledby="record-h" data-ssr="1">'
       head = '<p class="kicker">The Record</p><h2 id="record-h">What Congress voted on</h2>'
       if not bills:
           return f"{opening}{head}<p class=\"note\">We couldn't load recent bills right now.</p></section>"
       rows = bills[:7]
       missing = sum(1 for b in rows if not b.get("one_liner"))
       scope = "every bill that has had a roll-call vote"
       if since:
           scope += f" since {h(_month_year(since))}"
       stamp = f"As of {h(format_date(last_sync[:10]))} · {scope}" if last_sync else scope[0].upper() + scope[1:]
       stamp += ", newest activity first"
       if missing == 1:
           stamp += f" · 1 of the {len(rows)} bills below doesn't have a plain-English summary yet and shows its official title"
       elif missing:
           stamp += f" · {missing} of the {len(rows)} bills below don't have a plain-English summary yet and show their official title"
       parts = [opening, head, f'<p class="stamp meta">{stamp}.</p>', _record_lead(rows[0])]
       if len(rows) > 1:
           parts.append(f'<ul class="record-list">{"".join(_record_row(b) for b in rows[1:])}</ul>')
       show_latest = not rows[0].get("one_liner") and latest_summary and latest_summary.get("one_liner")
       if show_latest:
           parts.append(_latest_summary_block(latest_summary))
       if any(b.get("one_liner") for b in rows) or show_latest:
           parts.append(_ai_line(ai_updated))
       parts.append("</section>")
       return "".join(parts)


   def render_home(counts: dict, coverage: dict, vote: dict | None, bills: list | None,
                   latest_summary: dict | None, last_sync: str | None, ai_updated: str | None) -> str:
       """Home content for <!--content--> (spec §4.1 order): lead + card (m2, m3), the empty
       module-4 mount T4.2 fills for a remembered reader, then the Record (m5). The mount is
       below the finder, so filling it never moves the fold (§9.6). section.lead has no
       aria-label: a named section is a region landmark, and the spec's aside.vote-card
       would then be a complementary landmark nested two deep."""
       return (
           '<section class="lead">'
           f"{render_home_lead(counts, coverage)}{render_latest_vote_card(vote, ai_updated)}"
           "</section>"
           '<div class="home-reps" id="home-reps"></div>'
           f"{render_record(bills, last_sync, coverage.get('since'), latest_summary, ai_updated)}"
       )
   ```

3. [ ] **Harden `app/routers/notify.py`.** Change line 6 to `from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Request`, add `from app.render import NOTIFY_STATES` after line 12, and replace `submit_signup` (lines 47–72) with:
   ```python
   @router.post("")
   @limiter.limit("5/minute")
   async def submit_signup(signup: NotifySignup, request: Request) -> dict:
       # Spec §10 #16: the form lists only the 46 uncovered states + DC; anything else
       # (missing, a covered state, a name, a typo) is refused before anything is stored.
       state = signup.state.strip().upper()
       if state not in NOTIFY_STATES:
           raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Choose a state ClearVoting doesn't cover yet")
       timestamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()

       # gspread is synchronous — run it off the event loop.
       if _sheets.is_available and await run_in_threadpool(
           _sheets.append_row, [timestamp, signup.email, state]
       ):
           logger.info("Notify signup saved to Google Sheets: state=%s", state)
           return {"status": "ok"}

       entry = {"timestamp": timestamp, "email": signup.email, "state": state}
       NOTIFY_FILE.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
       with open(NOTIFY_FILE, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
           f.write(json.dumps(entry) + "\n")
       # Never log the email (spec §10 #16); the JSONL copy is the fallback record.
       logger.warning("signup saved to fallback, state=%s", state)
       return {"status": "ok"}
   ```
   (`NotifySignup.state` keeps `default=""`, so a missing field reaches the handler and gets the 400 rather than a 422.)

   ```python
   def _home_content(data_service) -> str:
       """Home blocks (spec §4.1). The Latest Vote card and the Record each degrade on

       metadata = data_service.get_sync_metadata()
   ```

8. [ ] **Rewrite `static/js/app.js` as the thin home enhancer.** Whole file:
   ```js
   /* ============================================
      ClearVoting — home enhancer (plan T3.3, spec §4.1)
      The server renders the lead, the Latest Vote card and the Record.
      This file adds only what belongs to this reader (the Latest Vote
      per-state line, from cv-home) and the browse panel at the foot.
      site.js loads first and provides el, displayName, chip,
      formatBillCode and formatDate, and runs the shared page inits.
      ============================================ */
   (function () {
       'use strict';

       const STATE_NAMES = { CA: 'California', FL: 'Florida', NY: 'New York', TX: 'Texas' };
       const ISSUE_CATEGORIES = [
           'Cost of Living', 'Healthcare', 'Jobs & Workers', 'Taxes',
           'Safety & Crime', 'Education', 'Money in Politics', 'Housing',
           'Immigration', 'Environment & Energy', 'Veterans & Military',
           'Social Security & Retirement',
       ];
       // Bare-string fallback only. A one-chamber adoption is final only for hres/sres,
       // which bill_status (T1.2) already decided in derived_status.variant.
       const FINAL_SEALS = /^(Became law|Passed both chambers)/;
       const BILL_LIMIT = 20;
       let billOffset = 0;
       let browseReady = false;

       document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
           addLatestVoteStateLine();
           initBrowsePanel();
       });

       function clear(node) { while (node.firstChild) node.removeChild(node.firstChild); }

       // Read-only here: cv-home is written only by site.js on the reader's own act (spec §5.4).
       function readHome() {
           try {
               const raw = localStorage.getItem('cv-home');
               const home = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : null;
               if (home && STATE_NAMES[home.state]) return home;
           } catch (e) { /* storage blocked or malformed: behave as a first visit */ }
           return null;
       }

       function billHref(bill) {
           return `/bill?congress=${encodeURIComponent(bill.congress)}` +
               `&type=${encodeURIComponent(String(bill.type || '').toLowerCase())}` +
               `&number=${encodeURIComponent(bill.number)}`;
       }

       /* ---- Latest Vote: "New York: 15 yes · 11 no · 0 didn't vote · Your rep, … — Voted yes" ---- */
       async function addLatestVoteStateLine() {
           const card = document.querySelector('aside.vote-card[data-ssr="1"]');
           const home = readHome();
           if (!card || card.classList.contains('vote-card--empty') || !home) return;
           let vote;
           try {
               const res = await fetch('/api/votes/latest');
               if (!res.ok) return;
               vote = await res.json();
           } catch (e) {
               return; // the server-rendered card is complete without this line
           }
           const tally = (vote.state_tallies || {})[home.state];
           if (!Array.isArray(tally)) return;
           const line = el('p', { className: 'meta latest-state' },
               `${STATE_NAMES[home.state]}: ${tally[0]} yes · ${tally[1]} no · ${tally[2]} didn't vote`);
           const covered = Object.values(vote.covered || {}).filter(m => m && m.state === home.state);
           const senate = vote.chamber === 'Senate';
           const reps = senate ? covered : covered.filter(m => Number(m.district) === Number(home.district));
           reps.forEach(m => {
               const who = senate ? displayName(m.name) : `Your rep, ${displayName(m.name)}`;
               line.appendChild(document.createTextNode(` · ${who} — `));
               // §4.4 m2 reader relation: a senator missing from the roll call reads
               // "Not in the Senate for this vote", never the chip's 'House' default.
               line.appendChild(chip(m.position, { chamber: vote.chamber }));
           });
           card.appendChild(line);
       }

       /* ---- Browse panel (collapsed; spec §3.1 /bills row, F38) ---- */
       function initBrowsePanel() {
           const toggle = document.getElementById('browse-toggle');
           const panel = document.getElementById('browse-panel');
           if (!toggle || !panel) return;
           toggle.addEventListener('click', () => setPanelOpen(toggle, panel, panel.hidden, ''));
           const q = (new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('q') || '').trim();
           if (q) {
               setPanelOpen(toggle, panel, true, q);
               toggle.scrollIntoView({ block: 'start', behavior: 'auto' });
           }
       }

       function setPanelOpen(toggle, panel, open, query) {
           panel.hidden = !open;
           toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(open));
           if (!open) { reflectQuery(''); return; }
           if (!browseReady) { browseReady = true; buildBrowse(); }
           if (query) {
               document.getElementById('bill-search').value = query;
               searchBills(query);
           } else if (!panel.dataset.loaded) {
               panel.dataset.loaded = '1';
               loadBrowseBills(false);
           }
       }

       // history.replaceState use #1 of 3 (spec §3.3): the panel's query lives in ?q=.
       function reflectQuery(q) {
           const url = new URL(window.location.href);
           if (q) url.searchParams.set('q', q); else url.searchParams.delete('q');
           history.replaceState(null, '', url.pathname + url.search + url.hash);
       }

       function buildBrowse() {
           const categoryGrid = document.getElementById('category-grid');
           ISSUE_CATEGORIES.forEach(cat => {
               const chipBtn = el('button', { className: 'category-chip', type: 'button', 'aria-pressed': 'false' }, cat);
               chipBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                   categoryGrid.querySelectorAll('.category-chip').forEach(c => c.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false'));
                   chipBtn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true');
                   document.getElementById('bill-search').value = cat;
                   searchBills(cat);
               });
               categoryGrid.appendChild(chipBtn);
           });
           document.getElementById('bill-search-form').addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
               e.preventDefault();
               const q = document.getElementById('bill-search').value.trim();
               if (q) { searchBills(q); } else { reflectQuery(''); loadBrowseBills(false); }
           });
           document.getElementById('load-more-btn').addEventListener('click', () => loadBrowseBills(true));
       }

       function statusSeal(bill) {
           const s = bill.derived_status;
           const text = typeof s === 'string' ? s : ((s && s.text) || 'No final vote yet');
           const variant = s && typeof s === 'object'
               ? (s.variant === 'final' ? 'final' : 'moving')   // trust bill_status (T1.2)
               : (FINAL_SEALS.test(text) ? 'final' : 'moving');
           return el('span', { className: `seal seal--${variant}` }, text);
       }

       function createBillRow(bill) {
           const code = formatBillCode(String(bill.type || '').toLowerCase(), bill.number);
           const date = bill.activity_date || (bill.latestAction && bill.latestAction.actionDate) || '';
           const meta = el('span', { className: 'row-meta' },
               el('span', { className: 'kicker' }, code),
               statusSeal(bill),
               date ? el('span', { className: 'meta' }, formatDate(date, true)) : null);
           const headline = bill.one_liner
               ? el('span', { className: 'row-headline' }, bill.one_liner)
               : el('span', { className: 'row-headline row-headline--official' }, bill.title || code);
           const pending = bill.one_liner ? null
               : el('span', { className: 'row-seal' }, el('span', { className: 'seal seal--pending' }, 'No plain-English summary yet'));
           return el('li', null, el('a', { className: 'bill-row', href: billHref(bill) }, meta, headline, pending));
       }

       async function loadBrowseBills(append) {
           const list = document.getElementById('bill-list');
           const results = document.getElementById('bill-results');
           const loadMore = document.getElementById('load-more-btn');
           const offset = append ? billOffset + BILL_LIMIT : 0;
           if (!append) { clear(list); results.textContent = 'Loading bills…'; }
           loadMore.disabled = true;
           try {
               const res = await fetch(`/api/bills?offset=${offset}&limit=${BILL_LIMIT}`);
               if (!res.ok) throw new Error(String(res.status));
               const bills = (await res.json()).bills || [];
               billOffset = offset; // advance only after a page actually arrived (F38)
               if (!append) results.textContent = '';
               bills.forEach(b => list.appendChild(createBillRow(b)));
               loadMore.hidden = bills.length < BILL_LIMIT;
           } catch (e) {
               results.textContent = "We couldn't load bills right now.";
           } finally {
               loadMore.disabled = false;
           }
       }

       async function searchBills(query) {
           const list = document.getElementById('bill-list');
           const results = document.getElementById('bill-results');
           document.getElementById('load-more-btn').hidden = true;
           reflectQuery(query);
           clear(list);
           results.textContent = 'Searching…';
           try {
               const res = await fetch(`/api/search/bills?q=${encodeURIComponent(query)}&limit=50`);
               if (!res.ok) throw new Error(String(res.status));
               const bills = (await res.json()).bills || [];
               results.textContent = bills.length
                   ? `${bills.length} bill${bills.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''} found for “${query}”`
                   : `No bills found for “${query}”. Try a broader term or pick a topic above.`;
               bills.forEach(b => list.appendChild(createBillRow(b)));
           } catch (e) {
               results.textContent = "We couldn't search the record right now. Please try again in a moment.";
           }
       }
   })();
   ```

```python
"""Delegation renderers: person rows, the state page, the ZIP finder and not-found pages
(plan T4.1; spec §4.2, §5.3, §6.4 person row, §7.4 ballot copy).

The renderers are pure string builders over an overview dict; FakeDS supplies the five
DataService reads they make, so every expected string here is exact."""
import re
from html.parser import HTMLParser

import pytest

from app import render

BALLOT_PERSON = re.compile(r"\b(On|Not on) the ballot")
STATUS_NODES = re.compile(r'<p class="[^"]*" role="status">([^<]*)</p>')
COUNTS = {"CA": 54, "FL": 29, "NY": 28, "TX": 39}
TERMS = {
    "G000602": {"item": [{"chamber": "House of Representatives", "startYear": 2025}]},
    "G000599": {"item": [{"chamber": "House of Representatives", "startYear": 2023}]},
    "X000001": {"item": [{"chamber": "House of Representatives", "startYear": 2021}]},
    "S000148": {"item": [
        {"chamber": "House of Representatives", "startYear": 1981, "endYear": 1999},
        {"chamber": "Senate", "startYear": 1999},
    ]},
    "G000555": {"item": [
        {"chamber": "House of Representatives", "startYear": 2007, "endYear": 2009},
        {"chamber": "Senate", "startYear": 2009},
    ]},
    "M001244": {"item": [{"chamber": "Senate", "startYear": 2025}]},
}
SUMMARIES = {
    "119-hr-4795": {"one_liner": "Sample one-liner for H.R. 4795", "provisions": []},
    "119-hr-6500": {"one_liner": "Sample withheld one-liner", "needs_review": True},
}
BILLS = {
    "119-hr-4795": {"title": "Sample official title for H.R. 4795"},
    "119-hr-6500": {"title": "Sample official title for H.R. 6500"},
}
VOTE_4795 = {"rc": "house/119_2_00295", "bill_id": "119-hr-4795", "position": "Yea", "date": "2026-09-03"}


class FakeDS:
    """The DataService reads the delegation renderers make, over hand-built data."""

    def __init__(self, summaries=None, bills=None, special=(), regular_senators=(), members=None):
        self.summaries = summaries or {}
        self.bills = bills or {}
        self.special = set(special)
        self.regular_senators = set(regular_senators)
        self.members = members or {}

    def displayable_summary(self, bill_id):
        summary = self.summaries.get(bill_id)
        if not summary or summary.get("needs_review") is True:
            return None
        return summary

    def get_bill_detail(self, congress, bill_type, number):
        bill = self.bills.get(f"{congress}-{bill_type.lower()}-{number}")
        return {"bill": bill} if bill else None

    def seat_up_2026(self, member):
        if "Senate" not in (member.get("chamber") or ""):
            return "regular"
        if member.get("bioguideId") in self.special:
            return "special"
        if member.get("bioguideId") in self.regular_senators:
            return "regular"
        return None

    def get_member_detail(self, bioguide_id):
        member = self.members.get(bioguide_id)
        return {"member": member} if member else None


def make_ds():
    return FakeDS(summaries=SUMMARIES, bills=BILLS, special={"M001244"},
                  members={bid: {"terms": terms} for bid, terms in TERMS.items()})


def member_raw(bioguide, name, *, district=None, chamber="House of Representatives",
               photo="", party="Democratic", latest_vote=None):
    return {"bioguideId": bioguide, "name": name, "district": district, "chamber": chamber,
            "photo": photo, "terms": [], "partyName": party, "latest_vote": latest_vote}


def ny_overview(districts_expected=10):
    return {
        "state": "NY",
        "state_name": "New York",
        "roster_as_of": "2026-09-05",
        "generated_at": "2026-09-22T00:00:00Z",
        "districts_expected": districts_expected,
        "senators": [
            member_raw("S000148", "Schumer, Charles E.", chamber="Senate",
                       photo="https://www.congress.gov/img/member/s000148_200.jpg",
                       latest_vote=dict(VOTE_4795, rc="senate/119_2_00210", position="Nay")),
            member_raw("G000555", "Gillibrand, Kirsten E.", chamber="Senate"),
        ],
        "house": [
            member_raw("G000599", "Goldman, Daniel S.", district=10,
                       latest_vote=dict(VOTE_4795, position="Not Voting")),
            member_raw("G000602", "Gillen, Laura", district=4,
                       photo="https://www.congress.gov/img/member/677427de0b34857ecc9090ad_200.jpg",
                       latest_vote=VOTE_4795),
            member_raw("X000001", "Example, Pat", district=1,
                       latest_vote=dict(VOTE_4795, bill_id="119-hr-6500")),
        ],
    }


def fields_for(bioguide):
    overview = ny_overview()
    raw = next(m for m in overview["senators"] + overview["house"] if m["bioguideId"] == bioguide)
    return render.overview_member_fields(raw, make_ds())


class _LinkNesting(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.depth = 0
        self.nested = False

    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        if tag == "a":
            if self.depth:
                self.nested = True
            self.depth += 1

    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        if tag == "a":
            self.depth -= 1


def has_nested_links(markup):
    parser = _LinkNesting()
    parser.feed(markup)
    parser.close()
    return parser.nested


def section(markup, opening):
    """The markup from `opening` to the first </section> after it."""
    return markup.split(opening, 1)[1].split("</section>", 1)[0]
```
