```python
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Delegation page (T4.1): person rows, the state page, the ZIP finder and the
# not-found page (spec §4.2, §5.3, §6.4 person row, §7.4 ballot copy)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# A lookup view of T3.1's COVERED_STATES tuple (one list of covered states in render.py).
COVERED_STATE_NAMES = dict(COVERED_STATES)
HOUSE_LOOKUP_URL = "https://www.house.gov/representatives/find-your-representative"
_DELEGATION_SITE_URL = "https://clearvoting.org"
_PENDING_SEAL = "No plain-English summary yet"
_COUNT_WORDS = {2: "two", 3: "three", 4: "four"}
_NAME_SUFFIXES = {"jr", "sr", "ii", "iii", "iv"}
_BILL_ID_RE = re.compile(r"^(\d+)-([a-z]+)-(\d+)$")


def _district_int(member: dict) -> int | None:
    district = member.get("district")
    return district if isinstance(district, int) and not isinstance(district, bool) else None


def _initials(full_name: str) -> str:
    words = [w for w in full_name.split() if w.strip(".,").lower() not in _NAME_SUFFIXES]
    letters = [w[0] for w in words if w[:1].isalpha()]
    if not letters:
        return ""
    return (letters[0] + letters[-1]).upper() if len(letters) > 1 else letters[0].upper()


def _bill_title(ds, congress: int, bill_type: str, number: int) -> str:
    # Most roster rows share one bill and get_bill_detail scans, so titles are memoized on
    # the DataService itself: the memo lives and dies with the data it caches, and a new
    # DataService (tests' cache_clear, a reload) starts with an empty one.
    memo = vars(ds).setdefault("_bill_title_memo", {})
    key = (congress, bill_type, number)
    if key not in memo:
        detail = ds.get_bill_detail(congress, bill_type, number)
        memo[key] = str(((detail or {}).get("bill") or {}).get("title") or "")
    return memo[key]


def _latest_vote_fields(latest: dict | None, ds) -> dict | None:
    if not latest:
        return None
    match = _BILL_ID_RE.match(str(latest.get("bill_id") or ""))
    if not match:
        return None
    congress, bill_type, number = int(match.group(1)), match.group(2), int(match.group(3))
    summary = ds.displayable_summary(latest["bill_id"]) or {}
    one_liner = str(summary.get("one_liner") or "")
    code = format_bill_code(bill_type, number)
    chip = position_chip(latest.get("position"))  # T1.2: the one §7.1 table
    date = str(latest.get("date") or "")[:10]
    return {
        **latest,
        "bill_code": code,
        "bill_url": f"/bill?congress={congress}&type={quote(bill_type)}&number={number}",
        "headline": one_liner or _bill_title(ds, congress, bill_type, number) or code,
        "displayable": bool(one_liner),
        "seal": "" if one_liner else _PENDING_SEAL,
        "chip": chip["text"],
        "chip_class": f"chip--{chip['variant']}",
        "date_short": format_date(date, short=True) if date else "",
    }


def overview_member_fields(member: dict, ds=None) -> dict:
    """One state_overview member plus the render-ready fields that the delegation page, the
    home "Your representatives" block and the bill slot use (§10 #7). Raw fields are kept,
    so the router's party strip still decides whether partyName leaves the server."""
    if ds is None:
        from app.dependencies import get_data_service
        ds = get_data_service()
    bioguide = str(member.get("bioguideId") or "")
    name = display_name(str(member.get("name") or ""))
    record = ((ds.get_member_detail(bioguide) if bioguide else None) or {}).get("member") or {}
    tenure = tenure_line(record["terms"]) if record.get("terms") else ""
    senate = "Senate" in str(member.get("chamber") or "")
    district = _district_int(member)
    if senate:
        seat = "U.S. Senator"
    elif district is not None:
        seat = f"District {district}"
    else:
        seat = "U.S. Representative"
    photo = str(member.get("photo") or (record.get("depiction") or {}).get("imageUrl") or "")
    return {
        **member,
        "display_name": name,
        "initials": _initials(name),
        "seat_line": f"{seat} · {tenure}" if tenure else seat,
        "seat_seal": seat_seal(ds.seat_up_2026(member), "row"),
        "url": f"/member?id={quote(bioguide)}",
        "photo": photo if photo.startswith("https://www.congress.gov/") else "",
        "latest_vote": _latest_vote_fields(member.get("latest_vote"), ds),
    }


def _photo(member: dict) -> str:
    src = str(member.get("photo") or "")
    img = (f'<img src="{h(src)}" alt="" loading="lazy" width="56" height="56">'
           if src.startswith("https://www.congress.gov/") else "")
    return f'<span class="photo" data-initials="{h(member.get("initials") or "")}">{img}</span>'


def _signal_line(signal: dict | None) -> str:
    if not signal:
        return '<span class="person-signal">No final votes on bills in our record yet</span>'
    if signal.get("displayable"):
        headline = h(signal.get("headline") or "")
    else:
        headline = (f'<span class="official">{h(signal.get("headline") or "")}</span> '
                    f'<span class="seal seal--pending">{h(signal.get("seal") or _PENDING_SEAL)}</span>')
    dated = f' · {h(signal["date_short"])}' if signal.get("date_short") else ""
    chip_class = h(signal.get("chip_class") or "chip--other")
    return (f'<span class="person-signal">Latest final vote{dated} · {headline} — '
            f'<span class="chip {chip_class}">{h(signal.get("chip") or "")}</span></span>')


def render_person_row(member: dict, signal: dict | None, split: bool = False,
                      state_code: str = "") -> str:
    """The §6.4 person row. By default the whole row is one <a>. With split=True (split and
    partial ZIP pages) the row is a <div> whose name is the link, with a sibling
    "This is my district →" link, so no link sits inside another (F60). Every row carries
    an empty .party span that the reveal fills."""
    bioguide = str(member.get("bioguideId") or "")
    district = _district_int(member)
    district_attr = "" if district is None else str(district)
    href = f"/member?id={quote(bioguide)}"
    attrs = (f' data-bioguide="{h(bioguide)}" data-state="{h(state_code)}"'
             f' data-district="{district_attr}"')
    seal = (f' <span class="seal seal--ballot">{h(member["seat_seal"])}</span>'
            if member.get("seat_seal") else "")
    details = (f' <span class="person-seat">{h(member.get("seat_line") or "")}</span>{seal}'
               f' {_signal_line(signal)} <span class="party"></span>')
    name = h(member.get("display_name") or "")
    if not split:
        return (f'<a class="person" href="{h(href)}"{attrs}>{_photo(member)} '
                f'<span class="person-body"><span class="person-name">{name}</span>{details}</span></a>')
    mine = f"/state?code={quote(state_code)}&district={district_attr}#mine"
    return (f'<div class="person person--split"{attrs}>{_photo(member)} '
            f'<span class="person-body"><a class="person-name" href="{h(href)}">{name}</a>{details}</span> '
            f'<a class="btn btn--secondary" href="{h(mine)}">This is my district →</a></div>')
```

```python
def _row_list(rows: list[str], css: str) -> str:
    return f'<ul class="{css}">' + "".join(f"<li>{row}</li>" for row in rows) + "</ul>"


def _vacant_row(state_code: str, district: int, *, report: bool = False, mine: bool = False) -> str:
    """A district with no member in members.json. In "Your representatives" (report=True) it
    reads "District 7 — vacant in our data · Tell us if this is wrong" (§4.2, §5.3) as one
    wrapping line: the inline .person-vacancy wrapper keeps the separator out of the row's
    grid. The roster's vacancies (report=False) are the name alone (§4.2 "Vacant districts")."""
    d = int(district)
    body = f'<span class="person-name">District {d} — vacant in our data</span>'
    if report:
        body = (f'<span class="person-vacancy">{body} · <button type="button" class="btn btn--secondary" '
                'data-feedback-open>Tell us if this is wrong</button></span>')
    mine_link = ""
    if mine:
        target = f"/state?code={quote(state_code)}&district={d}#mine"
        mine_link = f' <a class="btn btn--secondary" href="{h(target)}">This is my district →</a>'
    return (f'<div class="person person--vacant" data-state="{h(state_code)}" data-district="{d}">'
            f'<span class="person-body">{body}</span>{mine_link}</div>')


def _zip_note(zip_result: dict, matches: list[dict]) -> str:
    zip5 = h(zip_result.get("zip") or "")
    paras = []
    if len(matches) >= 2:
        word = _COUNT_WORDS.get(len(matches), str(len(matches)))
        first = (f"about {round(float(matches[0]['share']) * 100)} % of the ZIP's land area "
                 f"(not its residents) is in District {int(matches[0]['district'])}")
        others = [f"{round(float(m['share']) * 100)} % in District {int(m['district'])}"
                  for m in matches[1:]]
        if len(others) == 1:
            shares = f"{first} and {others[0]}"
        else:
            shares = f"{first}, " + ", ".join(others[:-1]) + f" and {others[-1]}"
        shown = "Both are shown" if len(matches) == 2 else f"All {word} are shown"
        paras.append(f"<p>ZIP {zip5} spans {word} House districts — {shares}. "
                     f"{shown}; your street address decides which is yours.</p>")
    if zip_result.get("kind") == "partial":
        outside = round((1 - float(zip_result.get("covered_share") or 0)) * 100)
        paras.append(f"<p>About {outside} % of ZIP {zip5}'s land area is outside California, Florida, "
                     "New York and Texas; if you live in that part, we don't cover your state yet.</p>")
    paras.append(f'<p><a class="source-link" href="{HOUSE_LOOKUP_URL}" rel="noopener">'
                 "Not sure? Look up your district by street address on house.gov →</a></p>")
    return '<div class="note">' + "".join(paras) + "</div>"


def _state_header(code: str, state_name: str, count: int, roster_as_of, district: int | None,
                  personal: bool, zip_value: str, error: str) -> str:
    kicker = f"{h(state_name)} · {int(count)} members"
    if roster_as_of:
        kicker += f" · roster as of {h(format_date(str(roster_as_of)[:10]))}"
    title = "Your representatives" if personal else f"{h(state_name)}'s representatives"
    if district is not None:
        where = (f'<p class="district-line">{h(state_name)}, District {int(district)} · '
                 '<a href="/#find">Change ZIP</a></p>'
                 # state.js unhides the button, and after a tap puts site.js's "Remembered: … ·
                 # Change · Forget" line in this wrapper, whose first control Forget refocuses.
                 '<div class="remember">'
                 f'<button type="button" class="btn btn--secondary" id="remember-district" '
                 f'data-state="{h(code)}" data-state-name="{h(state_name)}" '
                 f'data-district="{int(district)}" hidden>Remember District {int(district)} as mine</button>'
                 '</div>')
    else:
        # T3.1's compact ZIP form: the same component as home, one row (§4.2 header).
        where = render_zip_form(compact=True, value=zip_value, error=error or None,
                                form_id="zip-top", label="Where do you live?")
    # The place this page is about, for the feedback dialog's "About: …" line (T2.4): the h1
    # on district and ZIP pages is "Your representatives", which names no state.
    context_label = f"{state_name}, District {int(district)}" if district is not None else state_name
    party_url = f"/api/members/{quote(code)}/overview?show_party=true"
    share_url = f"{_DELEGATION_SITE_URL}/state?code={quote(code)}"
    share_title = f"{state_name}'s Representatives — Voting Records"
    share_text = f"How {state_name}'s members of Congress vote"
    return (f'<section class="state-header" data-state="{h(code)}" data-context-label="{h(context_label)}">'
            f'<p class="kicker">{kicker}</p>'
            f'<h1>{title}</h1>'
            f'{where}'
            '<div class="actions">'
            f'<button class="party-toggle" type="button" data-party-url="{h(party_url)}">Show party labels</button>'
            f'<button class="btn btn--secondary share-btn" type="button" data-share-url="{h(share_url)}" '
            f'data-share-title="{h(share_title)}" data-share-text="{h(share_text)}">Share</button>'
            '</div>'
            '<p class="party-status" role="status"></p>'
            '<p class="share-status" role="status"></p>'
            '<p class="meta">Party labels are hidden so the record speaks first.</p>'
            '<noscript><p class="meta">Party labels and remembering your district need JavaScript'
            '</p></noscript>'
            '</section>')


def _yours_section(code: str, senators: list[dict], by_district: dict[int, list[dict]],
                   district: int | None, zip_result: dict | None, matches: list[dict]) -> str:
    parts = ['<section class="yours" aria-labelledby="yours-h"><h2 id="yours-h">Your representatives</h2>']
    senator_rows = [render_person_row(m, m.get("latest_vote"), state_code=code) for m in senators]
    if district is not None:
        house_rows = [render_person_row(m, m.get("latest_vote"), state_code=code)
                      for m in by_district.get(district, [])]
        rows = senator_rows + (house_rows or [_vacant_row(code, district, report=True)])
        parts.append(_row_list(rows, "reps reps--yours"))
    else:
        parts.append(_row_list(senator_rows, "reps"))
        parts.append(_zip_note(zip_result or {}, matches))
        house_rows = []
        for match in matches:
            d = int(match["district"])
            members = by_district.get(d, [])
            house_rows += ([render_person_row(m, m.get("latest_vote"), split=True, state_code=code)
                            for m in members]
                           or [_vacant_row(code, d, report=True, mine=True)])
        parts.append(_row_list(house_rows, "reps"))
    parts.append("</section>")
    return "".join(parts)


def _senate_section(code: str, state_name: str, senators: list[dict]) -> str:
    rows = [render_person_row(m, m.get("latest_vote"), state_code=code) for m in senators]
    return ('<section class="senate" aria-labelledby="senate-h"><h2 id="senate-h">U.S. Senate</h2>'
            f'<p class="kicker">Both represent all of {h(state_name)}</p>{_row_list(rows, "reps")}</section>')


def _house_section(code: str, state_name: str, house: list[dict], by_district: dict[int, list[dict]],
                   expected: int, personal: bool) -> str:
    rows = []
    for d in range(1, expected + 1):
        members = by_district.get(d)
        if members:
            rows += [render_person_row(m, m.get("latest_vote"), state_code=code) for m in members]
        else:
            rows.append(_vacant_row(code, d))
    rows += [render_person_row(m, m.get("latest_vote"), state_code=code) for m in house
             if not (_district_int(m) is not None and 1 <= _district_int(m) <= expected)]
    listing = _row_list(rows, "roster")
    if personal:
        body = f"<details><summary>All {expected} {h(state_name)} House districts</summary>{listing}</details>"
    else:
        body = f'<p class="kicker">By district, 1–{expected}</p>{listing}'
    return ('<section class="house" id="house" aria-labelledby="house-h">'
            f'<h2 id="house-h">The House, by district</h2>{body}</section>')


def _state_foot(state_name: str, roster_as_of) -> str:
    roster = "Roster from Congress.gov"
    if roster_as_of:
        roster += f", as of {h(format_date(str(roster_as_of)[:10]))}"
    query = json.dumps({"congress": 119, "member-state": state_name}, separators=(",", ":"))
    congress_url = f"https://www.congress.gov/members?q={quote(query)}"
    foot_form = render_zip_form(compact=True, form_id="zip-foot",
                                label="Don't know your district? Enter your ZIP")
    return ('<div class="state-foot">'
            f'{foot_form}'
            f'<p class="meta">{roster} · Wrong person? '
            '<button type="button" class="btn btn--secondary" data-feedback-open>Report an error</button></p>'
            f'<p class="meta"><a class="source-link" href="{h(congress_url)}" rel="noopener">'
            f"{h(state_name)}'s delegation on Congress.gov →</a></p>"
            f'{render_notify_disclosure()}'
            '</div>')


def render_state_page(overview: dict, district: int | None = None, zip_result: dict | None = None,
                      error: str = "", *, ds=None, zip_value: str = "") -> str:
    """The delegation page body (§4.2): header, Your representatives (district or ZIP URLs
    only), U.S. Senate (plain URLs only), The House by district, foot. `district` is an int
    from the query string or None. `zip_result` is a lookup_zip result of kind split or
    partial for this state, or None."""
    code = str(overview.get("state") or "").upper()
    state_name = str(overview.get("state_name") or COVERED_STATE_NAMES.get(code, code))
    senators = sorted((overview_member_fields(m, ds) for m in overview.get("senators") or []),
                      key=lambda m: str(m.get("name") or ""))
    house = sorted((overview_member_fields(m, ds) for m in overview.get("house") or []),
                   key=lambda m: (_district_int(m) or 0, str(m.get("name") or "")))
    by_district: dict[int, list[dict]] = {}
    for member in house:
        d = _district_int(member)
        if d is not None:
            by_district.setdefault(d, []).append(member)
    expected = int(overview.get("districts_expected") or 0) or max(by_district, default=0)
    missing_district = None
    if district is not None and not 1 <= district <= expected:
        missing_district, district = district, None
    matches = [m for m in (zip_result or {}).get("matches") or [] if m.get("state") == code]
    personal = district is not None or bool(matches)

    blocks = [_state_header(code, state_name, len(senators) + len(house), overview.get("roster_as_of"),
                            district, personal, zip_value, error)]
    if missing_district is not None:
        blocks.append(f"<p class=\"note\">We don't have a District {int(missing_district)} in {h(state_name)}</p>")
    if personal:
        blocks.append(_yours_section(code, senators, by_district, district, zip_result, matches))
    else:
        blocks.append(_senate_section(code, state_name, senators))
    blocks.append(_house_section(code, state_name, house, by_district, expected, personal))
    blocks.append(_state_foot(state_name, overview.get("roster_as_of")))
    return '<div class="delegation">' + "".join(blocks) + "</div>"


def render_zip_finder_page(counts: dict, value: str = "", error: str = "") -> str:
    """/state with no code (§4.2 states): the finder H1, the ZIP form, the four state links."""
    return ('<div class="delegation"><section class="finder-page">'
            '<h1>Find your representatives</h1>'
            f'{render_zip_form(value=value, error=error or None, form_id="zip-top")}'
            f'<p class="meta">Or choose a state:</p>{render_state_links(counts)}'
            '</section></div>')


def render_zip_not_found(zip5: str, counts: dict) -> str:
    """/state?zip= with no district at ≥5 % in a covered state (§5.3): the one not-found
    message, the form, the four state links, then the notify disclosure."""
    z = h(zip5)
    message = (f"We couldn't match ZIP {z} to a congressional district in California, Florida, New York or "
               "Texas — the four states ClearVoting covers. If you live in one of them, your ZIP may be a "
               "PO-box or business ZIP: choose your state below, or "
               f'<a href="{HOUSE_LOOKUP_URL}" rel="noopener">look up your district by street address on '
               "house.gov →</a>. Somewhere else? Tell us your state and we'll email you when we add it.")
    return ('<div class="delegation"><section class="finder-page">'
            '<h1>Find your representatives</h1>'
            f'<div class="note"><p>{message}</p></div>'
            f'{render_zip_form(value=zip5, form_id="zip-top")}'
            f'<p class="meta">Or choose a state:</p>{render_state_links(counts)}'
            f'{render_notify_disclosure()}'
            '</section></div>')
```

- [ ] **Step 10: Add the delegation renderers to the escaping test.** T1.3's `RENDERERS` is a dict, and `test_renderer_escapes_hostile_input` is parametrized with `sorted(RENDERERS)`, which runs when the decorator is evaluated at import time, above the end of the file. Entries added at the end of the file would never be collected, so this block is a standalone parametrized test over its own `DELEGATION` dict, reusing T1.3's `HOSTILE` and `assert_escaped`. It leaves `RENDERERS` as it is. In `tests/test_render_escaping.py`, merge `from app import render` and `from tests.test_state_render import FakeDS, member_raw` into the import block (T1.3's block imports names from `app.render`, not the module). Then append at the end of the file:

```python
# --- Delegation renderers (plan T4.1) ---

def _delegation_ds(payload):
    return FakeDS(
        summaries={"119-hr-1": {"one_liner": payload}},
        bills={"119-hr-1": {"title": payload}, "119-hr-2": {"title": payload}},
        members={"G000602": {"terms": {"item": [{"chamber": "House of Representatives", "startYear": 2025}]}}},
    )


def _delegation_member(payload, bill_id="119-hr-1"):
    return member_raw("G000602", payload, district=4, photo=payload,
                      latest_vote={"rc": payload, "bill_id": bill_id, "position": payload,
                                   "date": "2026-09-03"})


def _render_person_rows_hostile(payload):
    ds = _delegation_ds(payload)
    rows = []
    for bill_id in ("119-hr-1", "119-hr-2"):  # a displayable headline, then the official-title fallback
        fields = render.overview_member_fields(_delegation_member(payload, bill_id), ds)
        rows.append(render.render_person_row(fields, fields["latest_vote"], state_code=payload))
        rows.append(render.render_person_row(fields, fields["latest_vote"], split=True, state_code=payload))
    return "".join(rows)


def _render_state_pages_hostile(payload):
    ds = _delegation_ds(payload)
    overview = {"state": "NY", "state_name": payload, "roster_as_of": "2026-09-05",
                "districts_expected": 5, "senators": [], "house": [_delegation_member(payload)]}
    partial = {"zip": payload, "kind": "partial", "covered_share": 0.5, "matches": [
        {"state": "NY", "district": 4, "share": 0.3}, {"state": "NY", "district": 5, "share": 0.2}]}
    return (render.render_state_page(overview, 4, None, payload, ds=ds, zip_value=payload)
            + render.render_state_page(overview, None, partial, payload, ds=ds, zip_value=payload)
            + render.render_state_page(overview, 40, None, "", ds=ds))


DELEGATION = {
    "render_person_row": _render_person_rows_hostile,
    "render_state_page": _render_state_pages_hostile,
    "render_zip_finder_page":
        lambda payload: render.render_zip_finder_page({"CA": 1}, value=payload, error=payload),
    "render_zip_not_found": lambda payload: render.render_zip_not_found(payload, {"CA": 1}),
}


@pytest.mark.parametrize("payload", HOSTILE)
@pytest.mark.parametrize("name", sorted(DELEGATION))
def test_delegation_renderer_escapes_hostile_input(name, payload):
    assert_escaped(DELEGATION[name](payload), payload)
```

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes:
  - T4.1:
    - `render.COVERED_STATE_NAMES`;
    - `render.overview_member_fields(member, ds=None)`;
    - `render.render_state_page(overview, district=None, zip_result=None, error="", *, ds=None, zip_value="")`;
    - `render.render_zip_finder_page(counts, value="", error="")`;
    - `render.render_zip_not_found(zip5, counts)`;
    - the DOM hooks listed under T4.1 Produces.
  - T3.1 `main.py`:
    - `_serve_html(filename: str, meta: dict | None = None, content_html: str | None = None, status_code: int = 200) -> HTMLResponse`: replaces the literal `<!--content-->` and fills `<!--edition-->` and `#data-freshness`;
    - `_page_content(build: Callable[[], str], meta: dict) -> tuple[str, int]`: `(html, 200)`, or, when `build()` raises, the §4 error state `render.render_error(meta["h1"])` with 503 (the cache rules make a 503 no-store).
  - T1.5: `DataService.lookup_zip(raw: str | None) -> dict | None`, the §5.2 contract: None for malformed input (it normalizes with `normalize_zip`, so ZIP+4 and surrounding spaces are accepted), `kind` "none" with empty `matches` when nothing matches. Also `DataService.districts_expected(code: str) -> int`, which is 0 for a state with no crosswalk rows.
  - T1.6: `DataService.get_state_overview(code: str, fallback: bool = False) -> dict | None`. With `fallback=True`, a missing file gives the members.json roster in the same shape (terms, sorting, `districts_expected`, `latest_vote` None, `generated_at` None); the missing-file warning is logged once, inside it.
  - `DataService.get_member_counts` (existing).
  - T2.2/T2.3 `site.js` globals, as classic-script functions:
    - `el(tag, attrs, ...children)`: `className` sets `class`, any other key uses setAttribute, and null/undefined/false values are skipped;
    - `personRow(member, stateCode, trailing)`: the DOM twin of `render.render_person_row` (photo through `photo()`, seat seal, `signalLine(member.latest_vote)`, the empty `.party` span), over one `overview_member_fields` object;
    - `readHome() -> {state, district, savedAt} | null`, `rememberDistrict(state, district) -> home | null` (null when storage refused it), `forgetHome()`, `rememberedLine(home, onForget) -> <p class="meta remembered-line">` ("Remembered: New York, District 4 · Change · Forget"; `onForget(line)` returns the container whose first control gets focus), `focusFirstControl(container)`, `COVERED_STATES` (code → name), `rewriteMastheadLink()`;
    - `initHome()`: writes `cv-home` on `#mine` and removes the fragment with `history.replaceState`;
    - `initPhotos()`;
    - `initPartyToggle()`: binds `.party-toggle`, fetches its `data-party-url` once on the first reveal, fills every `[data-bioguide] .party` from `payload.senators|house[].partyName`, flips the label, writes `.party-status` and keeps `sessionStorage['cv-show-party']`;
    - `initShare()`: binds `.share-btn` using its `data-share-*` attributes and writes `.share-status`.
  - T2.4 `feedback.js` (as amended for this task, see the cross-group note in Step 1): every `[data-feedback-open]` button, including ones JavaScript adds later, opens the dialog through a delegated click listener with `openModal(trigger)`, so focus returns straight to that trigger on close; on `/state` the "About: …" context prefers `.state-header[data-context-label]` over the h1 text.
  - T3.2 home lead: `form#find` (T3.1 `render_zip_form()`, input `#zip`) and the empty `<div class="home-reps" id="home-reps"></div>` mount that `render_home` places directly after `</section>` of `section.lead` (so after the Latest Vote card) and before `section.record`: below the finder, so filling it never moves the fold, and giving the outline h1 → The latest vote → Your representatives → What Congress voted on (§8 item 2).
  - T1.5: `tests/test_payload_privacy.py` `CHECKED_ENDPOINTS`, the list of default GET paths the party and payload-key tests walk.
- Produces:
  - `/state` contract:
    - `?zip=` with a single covered match → **302** `/state?code=XX&district=N#mine`;
    - split or partial → **302** `/state?code=XX&zip=NNNNN`, which renders **200**;
    - none → **200** not-found at the ZIP URL;
    - malformed → **200** with "A ZIP code is five digits.", the value kept and `aria-describedby`;
    - `code` and `zip` that disagree → **302** to the ZIP's state;
    - no `code` → **200** finder;
    - invalid `code` → **404**;
    - every ZIP 302 carries `Cache-Control: public, max-age=0, s-maxage=86400`.
  - `GET /api/members/{state}/overview?show_party=` returns `{state, state_name, roster_as_of, generated_at, districts_expected, senators[], house[]}`. Each member is `overview_member_fields` output; the party fields are stripped unless `show_party=true`. Uncovered state → 404, malformed → 400.
  - `static/js/app.js` `initYourRepresentatives()`: home module 4, mounted in `#home-reps`.
  - `static/js/state.js`: the delegation enhancer (party reveal, Remember, Share); the feedback triggers are T2.4's.

**Resolves:** spec §3.1 (the `/state` row), §3.2 (steps 1–2 and 5), §4.1 m4 (home "Your representatives" and the fallback "Remembered from your last visit" line), §4.2 (states, party reveal, no-JS), §5.3, §5.4 (Remember button, `#mine`, Forget), §5.5 (the typeable, linkable `/state?code=NY&district=4` URL with its Remember button; the full House roster is the district picker, no separate `<select>`), §9.5 (the `/state?zip=` 302 header), §10 #5, §10 #7, §10.3 commit 4; findings F03, F04, F05, F06, F20, F34.

- [ ] **Step 4: Implement the file-backed overview.** In `app/routers/members.py`, add `from app import render` to the import block. Then locate the old endpoint by name: `grep -n '@router.get("/{state_code}/overview")' app/routers/members.py` gives its first line, and `grep -n '@router.get("/{state_code}")' app/routers/members.py` gives the first line after it. Replace everything from the first of those lines up to (not including) the second with the block below. The missing-file fallback is T1.6's `get_state_overview(code, fallback=True)`, which already returns the members.json roster in the file's shape and logs the warning once, so the router adds no roster builder of its own:

```python
@router.get("/{state_code}/overview")
def get_state_overview(
    state_code: str,
    show_party: bool = Query(False, description="Include party labels (hidden by default)"),
):
    """One state's delegation for the home block, the bill slot and the party reveal:
    one cached file read, no per-member vote files (F05)."""
    state_code = _validate_state_code(state_code)
    if state_code not in render.COVERED_STATE_NAMES:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="State not covered")
    data_service = get_data_service()
    # The committed file; if it is missing, T1.6's members.json roster without signal lines.
    overview = data_service.get_state_overview(state_code, fallback=True) or {}
    payload = {
        "state": overview.get("state") or state_code,
        "state_name": overview.get("state_name"),
        "roster_as_of": overview.get("roster_as_of"),
        "generated_at": overview.get("generated_at"),
        "districts_expected": overview.get("districts_expected"),
        "senators": [render.overview_member_fields(m, data_service) for m in overview.get("senators") or []],
        "house": [render.overview_member_fields(m, data_service) for m in overview.get("house") or []],
    }
    return payload if show_party else _strip_party(payload)
```

- [ ] **Step 8: Implement the `/state` route.** In `app/main.py`:
  - Add `HTTPException` to `from fastapi import FastAPI, Request`.
  - Add `RedirectResponse` to the `fastapi.responses` import.
  - `from app import render` is already there (T3.1).
  - Replace `serve_state` (find it with `grep -n "def serve_state" app/main.py`) with the block below. Every 200 branch renders through T3.1's `_page_content`, so an exception while rendering (a malformed overview file, a missing index entry) shows the spec §4 error state (masthead, this page's H1 from `meta["h1"]`, the one sentence, 503) instead of a bare 500. ZIP parsing is T1.5's `lookup_zip`, which returns None for malformed input, so there is no second ZIP regex here.

```python
# The lookup is static per deploy, so the edge may keep a ZIP's redirect for a day (§9.5).
_ZIP_REDIRECT_CACHE = "public, max-age=0, s-maxage=86400"
_ZIP_ERROR = "A ZIP code is five digits."
_FINDER_H1 = "Find your representatives"
_YOURS_H1 = "Your representatives"


def _zip_redirect(target: str) -> RedirectResponse:
    return RedirectResponse(target, status_code=302, headers={"Cache-Control": _ZIP_REDIRECT_CACHE})


def _zip_target(result: dict) -> str | None:
    """Where a ZIP lookup sends the reader (§3.1). A single covered match goes to the
    district URL with #mine (site.js writes cv-home from it). A split or partial match goes
    to code + zip, which renders 200 and writes nothing. No match returns None."""
    matches = result.get("matches") or []
    if not matches:
        return None
    first = matches[0]
    if result.get("kind") == "single":
        return f"/state?code={first['state']}&district={int(first['district'])}#mine"
    if result.get("kind") in ("split", "partial"):
        return f"/state?code={first['state']}&zip={result['zip']}"
    return None


def _parse_district(raw: str | None) -> int | None:
    value = (raw or "").strip()
    return int(value) if value.isdigit() and len(value) <= 3 else None


def _serve_state_page(code: str | None, h1: str, build) -> HTMLResponse:
    """One /state page through T3.1's _page_content: `build()` renders the body, and if it
    raises, the §4 error state shows `h1` (the H1 this URL would have had) with a 503."""
    meta = {**_state_meta(code), "h1": h1}
    content, status = _page_content(build, meta)
    return _serve_html("state.html", meta, content, status_code=status)


@app.get("/state")
def serve_state(request: Request):
    """The delegation page and the ZIP form's target (§3.1, §5.3). Plain def: the overview
    read runs in the threadpool."""
    from app.dependencies import get_data_service
    data_service = get_data_service()
    params = request.query_params
    code = (params.get("code") or "").strip().upper()
    if code and code not in render.COVERED_STATE_NAMES:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)
    state_h1 = f"{render.COVERED_STATE_NAMES[code]}'s representatives" if code else _FINDER_H1

    raw_zip = (params.get("zip") or "").strip()
    lookup = None
    if raw_zip:
        lookup = data_service.lookup_zip(raw_zip)  # T1.5: None when the input is not a ZIP
        if lookup is None:
            if not code:
                return _serve_state_page(None, _FINDER_H1, lambda: render.render_zip_finder_page(
                    data_service.get_member_counts(), value=raw_zip, error=_ZIP_ERROR))
            return _serve_state_page(code, state_h1, lambda: render.render_state_page(
                data_service.get_state_overview(code, fallback=True), None, None, _ZIP_ERROR,
                ds=data_service, zip_value=raw_zip))
        target = _zip_target(lookup)
        if target is None:
            return _serve_state_page(None, _FINDER_H1, lambda: render.render_zip_not_found(
                lookup["zip"], data_service.get_member_counts()))
        renders_here = (lookup["kind"] in ("split", "partial")
                        and any(m.get("state") == code for m in lookup["matches"]))
        if not renders_here:
            return _zip_redirect(target)

    if not code:
        return _serve_state_page(None, _FINDER_H1, lambda: render.render_zip_finder_page(
            data_service.get_member_counts()))
    district = None if lookup else _parse_district(params.get("district"))
    # The error state's H1 follows the URL shape: district and ZIP URLs lead with "Your representatives".
    h1 = _YOURS_H1 if (lookup is not None or district is not None) else state_h1
    return _serve_state_page(code, h1, lambda: render.render_state_page(
        data_service.get_state_overview(code, fallback=True), district, lookup, "",
        ds=data_service, zip_value=lookup["zip"] if lookup else ""))
```

`_state_meta` stays as it is. Every code reaching it is now a validated upper-case covered code or None, and T8.1 rewrites its title format.

- [ ] **Step 13: Rewrite `static/js/state.js` as a thin enhancer.** Replace the whole file (419 lines) with the block below. Every helper it calls is a site.js global (T2.2/T2.3); the party reveal is `initPartyToggle()` over the toggle's `data-party-url` (the default fill writes each `[data-bioguide] .party` span from the payload, and `partyName` in the data is already "Democratic"/"Republican"/"Independent"); the "Report an error" and "Tell us if this is wrong" buttons are opened by feedback.js (T2.4), so this file binds none of them.

```js
/* ============================================
   ClearVoting — Delegation page enhancer (plan T4.2; spec §4.2, §5.4)
   The server renders the whole page (app/render.py render_state_page).
   This adds only what belongs to this reader: the party reveal, the
   "Remember District N as mine" button and Share. Every helper is a
   site.js global; the feedback buttons belong to feedback.js.
   ============================================ */
(function () {
    'use strict';

    // "Remember District 4 as mine": shown only when cv-home is not already this district.
    // A tap replaces it with the site-wide "Remembered: New York, District 4 · Change ·
    // Forget" line (§5.4), which takes focus so it is read out. Forget brings the button
    // back and focuses it. If storage refuses the write, nothing changes and nothing is said.
    function initRememberButton() {
        const button = document.getElementById('remember-district');
        if (!button) return;
        const state = button.getAttribute('data-state');
        const district = Number(button.getAttribute('data-district'));
        const home = readHome();
        if (home && home.state === state && home.district === district) return;
        const wrapper = button.parentNode;
        button.hidden = false;
        button.addEventListener('click', () => {
            const saved = rememberDistrict(state, district);
            if (!saved) return;
            rewriteMastheadLink();
            const line = rememberedLine(saved, (shown) => {
                shown.remove();
                button.hidden = false;
                return wrapper;
            });
            line.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1');
            button.hidden = true;
            wrapper.appendChild(line);
            line.focus();
        });
    }

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
        initHome();          // writes cv-home from #mine and removes the fragment, before the Remember check
        initPhotos();
        initPartyToggle();   // fetches .party-toggle[data-party-url] once and fills the .party spans
        initShare();
        initRememberButton();
    });
})();
```

- [ ] **Step 14: Add home module 4 to `static/js/app.js`.** Inside the file's `DOMContentLoaded` handler (as T3.3 left it), add `initYourRepresentatives();` as its last call. Append this block at the end of the file. It is the same component as the delegation page (§4.1 m4 "Same component, same copy, no separate design"): the rows are site.js `personRow()` (photo through `photo()`, the ballot seal, `signalLine()` and the empty `.party` span), the remembered district is site.js `readHome()`, and Forget uses site.js `forgetHome()`, `rewriteMastheadLink()` and `focusFirstControl()`. Only the vacant row, the block's head and the failure line are local, because no site.js builder has that copy.

```js
/* ---- Home module 4: "Your representatives" (plan T4.2; spec §4.1 m4, §5.4) ----
   Only for a reader with a remembered district (site.js readHome()). The rows are site.js
   personRow(), built from the same render-ready /api/members/{state}/overview payload as
   the delegation page. The block fills T3.2's empty #home-reps mount, which sits after
   section.lead (after the Latest Vote card) and before the Record, so it never moves the
   fold. If the fetch fails, one "Remembered from your last visit" line appears under the
   Find button instead. Forget clears either one and focuses the ZIP field (form#find). */
function homeVacantRow(home) {
    // Spec §5.3: the crosswalk names this district, but members.json has no one in it.
    // The button is opened by feedback.js's delegated [data-feedback-open] listener (T2.4).
    return el('div', { className: 'person person--vacant', 'data-state': home.state, 'data-district': String(home.district) },
        el('span', { className: 'person-body' },
            el('span', { className: 'person-vacancy' },
                el('span', { className: 'person-name' }, `District ${home.district} — vacant in our data`),
                ' · ',
                el('button', { type: 'button', className: 'btn btn--secondary', 'data-feedback-open': true },
                    'Tell us if this is wrong'))));
}

function forgetHomeBlock(clearBlock) {
    forgetHome();
    rewriteMastheadLink();
    clearBlock();
    focusFirstControl(document.getElementById('find'));  // the ZIP input, #zip
}

function showRememberedFallback(home) {
    const finder = document.getElementById('find');
    if (!finder) return;
    const forget = el('button', { type: 'button', className: 'btn--secondary' }, 'Forget');
    const line = el('p', { className: 'meta remembered-line' },
        `Remembered from your last visit: ${COVERED_STATES[home.state]}, District ${home.district} → `,
        el('a', { href: `/state?code=${home.state}&district=${home.district}` }, 'Show my representatives'),
        ' · ', forget);
    forget.addEventListener('click', () => forgetHomeBlock(() => line.remove()));
    finder.appendChild(line);  // under the Find button, inside form#find
}

async function initYourRepresentatives() {
    const home = readHome();
    const mount = document.getElementById('home-reps');
    if (!home || !mount) return;
    try {
        const response = await fetch(`/api/members/${encodeURIComponent(home.state)}/overview`);
        if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`overview ${response.status}`);
        const data = await response.json();
        const list = el('ul', { className: 'reps reps--yours' });
        (data.senators || []).forEach((m) => list.appendChild(el('li', null, personRow(m, home.state))));
        const house = (data.house || []).filter((m) => m.district === home.district);
        if (house.length) house.forEach((m) => list.appendChild(el('li', null, personRow(m, home.state))));
        else list.appendChild(el('li', null, homeVacantRow(home)));
        const forget = el('button', { type: 'button', className: 'btn--secondary' }, 'Forget');
        forget.addEventListener('click', () => forgetHomeBlock(() => mount.replaceChildren()));
        mount.appendChild(el('section', { className: 'yours home-yours', 'aria-labelledby': 'home-yours-h' },
            el('h2', { id: 'home-yours-h' }, 'Your representatives'),
            el('p', { className: 'meta remembered-line' }, 'remembered from your last visit · ',
                el('a', { href: '/#find' }, 'Change'), ' · ', forget),
            list));
    } catch (e) {
        showRememberedFallback(home);
    }
}
```

`COVERED_STATES`, `readHome`, `personRow`, `focusFirstControl`, `forgetHome` and `rewriteMastheadLink` are site.js top-level names, which classic scripts share. If T3.3's `app.js` redeclares any of those site.js names, delete app.js's copy and keep site.js's: a second top-level `const` with the same name is a SyntaxError in a classic script. Before appending, confirm the four new names are free with `grep -nE "function (homeVacantRow|forgetHomeBlock|showRememberedFallback|initYourRepresentatives)\b" static/js/app.js static/js/site.js` (no output).

```python
class _Outline(HTMLParser):
    """(level, text) of every h1–h6 inside <main> (the dialog's h2 sits outside <main>)."""

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.in_main = 0
        self.current = None
        self.headings: list[tuple[int, str]] = []

    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        if tag == "main":
            self.in_main += 1
        elif self.in_main and re.fullmatch(r"h[1-6]", tag):
            self.current = [int(tag[1]), ""]

    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        if tag == "main":
            self.in_main -= 1
        elif self.current and tag == f"h{self.current[0]}":
            self.headings.append((self.current[0], self.current[1].strip()))
            self.current = None

    def handle_data(self, data):
        if self.current:
            self.current[1] += data


def _outline(html: str) -> list[tuple[int, str]]:
    parser = _Outline()
    parser.feed(html)
    return parser.headings


def _assert_h1_then_h2(outline):
    assert outline, "no headings inside <main>"
    assert outline[0][0] == 1
    assert [level for level, _ in outline].count(1) == 1
    for (prev, _), (level, text) in zip(outline, outline[1:]):
        assert level <= prev + 1, f"heading level skipped at {text!r}"
    assert any(level == 2 for level, _ in outline[1:])
```

```python
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Trust pages: About counts, Methodology blocks, the 404 body (plan Task T5.1)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

_TRUST_STATE_NAMES = {"CA": "California", "FL": "Florida", "NY": "New York", "TX": "Texas"}
_TRUST_NUMBER_WORDS = ("no", "one", "two", "three", "four", "five", "six", "seven", "eight", "nine", "ten")
_PROMPT_RULE_RE = re.compile(r"^(\d+)\.\s+(.+)$")
_TRUST_CROSSWALK_PREFIX = "https://www2.census.gov/"
_TRUST_SENATE_PREFIX = "https://www.senate.gov/"


def prompt_rules(prompt: str) -> dict[str, list[str]]:
    """The two numbered rule lists of the bill-summary prompt, verbatim.

    "STRICT RULES:" opens the neutrality list and "ACCURACY RULES" the accuracy list;
    a blank line after a list's items ends it. /methodology prints both, and a test
    checks the page equals the prompt, so the page can never drift from the prompt."""
    lists: dict[str, list[str]] = {"neutrality": [], "accuracy": []}
    current = None
    for line in prompt.splitlines():
        stripped = line.strip()
        if stripped.startswith("STRICT RULES"):
            current = "neutrality"
            continue
        if stripped.startswith("ACCURACY RULES"):
            current = "accuracy"
            continue
        if not stripped:
            if current and lists[current]:
                current = None
            continue
        match = _PROMPT_RULE_RE.match(stripped)
        if current and match:
            lists[current].append(match.group(2))
    return lists


def _trust_count(n) -> str:
    return f"{int(n):,}"


def _trust_number_word(n: int) -> str:
    return _TRUST_NUMBER_WORDS[n] if 0 <= n < len(_TRUST_NUMBER_WORDS) else f"{n:,}"


def _trust_iso(value) -> str | None:
    """The YYYY-MM-DD prefix of value when it is a real date, else None."""
    if not value:
        return None
    text = str(value)[:10]
    try:
        date.fromisoformat(text)
    except ValueError:
        return None
    return text


def _trust_month_year(value) -> str | None:
    iso = _trust_iso(value)
    return date.fromisoformat(iso).strftime("%B %Y") if iso else None


def _trust_long_date(value) -> str | None:
    iso = _trust_iso(value)
    return format_date(iso) if iso else None


def _trust_links(url_field, prefix: str) -> str:
    """Anchors for a _source url field ("A and B" allowed); only https URLs under prefix."""
    urls = [u.strip() for u in str(url_field or "").split(" and ")]
    return " · ".join(f'<a href="{h(u)}">{h(u)}</a>' for u in urls if u.startswith(prefix))


def _trust_section(anchor: str, heading: str, body: str) -> str:
    # anchor and heading are literals from this module, never data.
    return (f'<section id="{anchor}" aria-labelledby="{anchor}-h">'
            f'<h2 id="{anchor}-h">{heading}</h2>{body}</section>')


def render_about_counts(counts: dict) -> str:
    """The "What we cover" sentence on /about (spec §4.5), from the /api/health counts."""
    since = _trust_month_year(counts.get("since"))
    scope = "every bill that has had a roll-call vote" + (f" since {h(since)}" if since else "")
    return (
        f"<p>California, Florida, New York and Texas today: {_trust_count(counts['members'])} members "
        f"and {_trust_count(counts['bills'])} bills — {scope}. The site is in English only for now.</p>"
    )


def _methodology_coverage(counts: dict) -> str:
    since = _trust_month_year(counts.get("since"))
    since_txt = f" since {h(since)}" if since else ""
    return _trust_section("coverage", "What we cover", (
        f"<p>ClearVoting holds {_trust_count(counts['bills'])} bills — every bill that has had a "
        f"roll-call vote{since_txt} in the House or Senate. Bills that never reached a roll-call vote "
        "are not in our data.</p>"
        "<p>Senate records on member pages include votes on bills, amendments and motions; the "
        f"{_trust_count(counts['nominations'])} Senate votes on nominations{since_txt} aren't included "
        "yet. House records include every House roll call.</p>"
    ))


def _methodology_ai(counts: dict, rules: dict) -> str:
    neutrality = rules.get("neutrality", [])
    accuracy = rules.get("accuracy", [])
    updated = _trust_long_date(counts.get("ai_summaries_updated"))
    updated_txt = f" Plain-English summaries were last updated {h(updated)}." if updated else ""
    return _trust_section("ai", "What AI writes, and what it never touches", (
        "<p>An AI model writes each bill's one-line summary and its list of provisions, from the "
        "bill's title, official summary and a text excerpt. It never touches votes, tallies, dates, "
        "names, outcomes or party.</p>"
        "<h3>Our rules for neutrality</h3>"
        "<p>The AI is given these rules, word for word, every time it writes a summary:</p>"
        '<ol class="rules" id="neutrality-rules">'
        + "".join(f"<li>{h(rule)}</li>" for rule in neutrality)
        + "</ol>"
        "<h3>Our rules for accuracy</h3>"
        f'<ol class="rules" id="accuracy-rules" start="{len(neutrality) + 1}">'
        + "".join(f"<li>{h(rule)}</li>" for rule in accuracy)
        + "</ol>"
        f"<p>{_trust_count(counts['shown'])} of {_trust_count(counts['bills'])} bills have a "
        f"plain-English summary. {_trust_count(counts['missing'])} have none yet, and "
        f"{_trust_count(counts['withheld'])} summaries are withheld because they did not pass our "
        f"automated accuracy check; those bills show their official title.{updated_txt}</p>"
        f"<p>{_trust_count(counts['audited'])} summaries were spot-checked by a second AI review.</p>"
        "<p>Member summaries are withdrawn until they can be rewritten without stance labels.</p>"
        "<p>We do not publish arguments for or against a bill. An earlier version showed AI-drafted "
        "'supporters say / critics say' bullets; they were unattributed and have been removed until "
        "they can be sourced.</p>"
    ))


def _methodology_recent_votes() -> str:
    # The rule exactly as DataService.get_member_page applies it (spec §4.3 m2).
    return _trust_section("recent-votes", "How “Recent votes” are chosen", (
        "<p>The “Recent votes” list on each member page is chosen by one rule, and the rule never "
        "looks at how the member voted:</p>"
        "<ol>"
        "<li>We consider the member's roll-call votes on a bill that has a plain-English summary we "
        "show and a policy area, where the vote was on the bill itself — a final vote to pass or "
        "adopt it, to accept the other chamber's changes, to override a veto or to ratify a treaty — "
        "and the member voted yes (Yea or Aye) or no (Nay or No).</li>"
        "<li>Going from newest to oldest, we keep the first such vote on each bill. A bill counts as "
        "used only once one of its votes is picked, so a vote the member missed never hides one they "
        "cast.</li>"
        "<li>We take one vote per policy area in turn, starting with the area whose newest vote is "
        "most recent, and go round the areas again until we have eight. So the first pick is always "
        "the newest qualifying vote.</li>"
        "<li>The eight are shown newest first. A member with fewer qualifying votes shows as many as "
        "qualify.</li>"
        "</ol>"
        "<p>Amendments, procedural motions and votes on nominations are never in this list. Every "
        "vote in our record is in the member's full record below it; Senate votes on nominations "
        "are not in our record yet (see What we cover).</p>"
    ))


def _methodology_counts() -> str:
    return _trust_section("counts", "Counts, never grades", (
        "<p>We show roll calls voted as a count, never as a grade, and never rank members by it.</p>"
        "<p>A member page says how many of the roll calls in our record the member voted in, and "
        "since when. It never turns that into a percentage, a colour or a score.</p>"
    ))


def _methodology_zip(sources: dict) -> str:
    source_p = ""
    if sources.get("name"):
        retrieved = _trust_long_date(sources.get("retrieved"))
        source_p = (
            f"<p>Source: {h(sources['name'])}"
            + (f" ({h(sources['licence'])})" if sources.get("licence") else "")
            + (f", retrieved {h(retrieved)}" if retrieved else "")
            + ".</p>"
        )
    links = _trust_links(sources.get("url"), _TRUST_CROSSWALK_PREFIX)
    return _trust_section("zip", "ZIP codes and districts", (
        "<p>To find your representatives from a ZIP code, we use the Census Bureau's table of which "
        "congressional districts each ZIP code area overlaps.</p>"
        + source_p
        + (f'<p class="meta">{links}</p>' if links else "")
        + "<p>Shares are land area, not population; PO-box-only and business ZIPs are not in the "
        "Census file; a ZIP that crosses a state line is shown with a note.</p>"
        "<p>A district counts as a match when it covers at least 5 % of the ZIP's land area. When one "
        "district matches and at least 95 % of the ZIP's land is in California, Florida, New York or "
        "Texas, we take you straight to that district. When two to four districts match, we show "
        "each one with its share and you choose. When less than 95 % of the ZIP's land is in our four "
        "states, we show the match with a note and remember it only if you choose it.</p>"
        # Same link and copy as T4.1's split/partial note (spec §5.5: rel=noopener, same tab).
        f'<p><a class="source-link" href="{HOUSE_LOOKUP_URL}" rel="noopener">'
        "Not sure? Look up your district by street address on house.gov →</a></p>"
    ))


def _methodology_ballot(counts: dict, senate: dict) -> str:
    day = _trust_long_date(senate.get("election_day"))
    if not day:
        return _trust_section("ballot", "Seats on the ballot",
                              "<p>Ballot details aren't available right now.</p>")
    clauses = []
    for seat in senate.get("seats", []):
        state = _TRUST_STATE_NAMES.get(seat.get("state"))
        if not state:
            continue
        name = h(display_name(seat.get("name") or ""))
        if seat.get("kind") == "special":
            clauses.append(f"the {state} seat held by {name} is up in a special election")
        else:
            clauses.append(f"the {state} seat held by {name} is up for its regular election")
    senators = _trust_number_word(int(counts.get("senators", 0)))
    if clauses:
        joined = clauses[0] if len(clauses) == 1 else ", ".join(clauses[:-1]) + " and " + clauses[-1]
        senate_txt = f"Of the {senators} senators we cover, {joined}."
    else:
        senate_txt = f"None of the Senate seats held by the {senators} senators we cover is up in this election."
    source = senate.get("_source") or {}
    retrieved = _trust_long_date(source.get("retrieved"))
    source_txt = " Source: senate.gov class lists" + (f", retrieved {h(retrieved)}" if retrieved else "") + "."
    links = _trust_links(source.get("url"), _TRUST_SENATE_PREFIX)
    # _source.method names party letters; it is never rendered.
    return _trust_section("ballot", "Seats on the ballot", (
        f"<p>Every House seat is on the ballot on {h(day)}. {senate_txt}{source_txt}</p>"
        + (f'<p class="meta">{links}</p>' if links else "")
        + "<p>These are facts about the seats, not about the people in them: our data does not say "
        "who is running.</p>"
    ))


def render_methodology(counts: dict, sources: dict, rules: dict[str, list[str]], senate_source: dict) -> str:
    """The server-filled run of /methodology, #coverage through #ballot (spec §4.6).

    counts: main._trust_counts(); sources: DataService._crosswalk_source (the _source block of
    zip_districts.json); rules: prompt_rules(SYSTEM_PROMPT); senate_source: DataService._senate_file
    (the whole senate_2026.json). All three data inputs were loaded at startup."""
    return "".join([
        _methodology_coverage(counts),
        _methodology_ai(counts, rules),
        _methodology_recent_votes(),
        _methodology_counts(),
        _methodology_zip(sources),
        _methodology_ballot(counts, senate_source),
    ])


def render_not_found(zip_form: str, state_links: str) -> str:
    """The 404 body (spec §4.8): kicker, the only heading, one sentence, the ZIP form, the four
    state links and a front-page link. Both arguments are HTML built by render_zip_form and
    render_state_links."""
    return (
```

```python
def _trust_counts() -> dict:
    """Counts for /about and /methodology — the same numbers /api/health reports."""
    from app.dependencies import get_data_service
    ds = get_data_service()
    coverage = ds.coverage_counts()
    return {
        "members": len(ds._members),
        "senators": sum(1 for m in ds._members if m.get("chamber") == "Senate"),
        "bills": coverage["bills"],
        "shown": coverage["shown"],
        "missing": coverage["missing"],
        "withheld": coverage["withheld"],
        "audited": coverage["audited"],
        "nominations": coverage["nominations_excluded"],
        "since": ds.earliest_roll_call_date(),
        "ai_summaries_updated": ds.get_sync_metadata().get("ai_summaries_updated"),
    }


def _trust_block(build) -> tuple[str, int]:
    """Run a trust page's server-filled block (spec §4 "Common to every page").

    T3.1's _page_content can't be used here: render_error emits its own <h1>, and on these
    shells the <!--content--> marker sits under the shell's static h1. So on failure this
    logs and returns only the error sentence, with 503 (no-store under T8.2's rules)."""
    try:
        return build(), 200
    except Exception:
        logger.exception("trust page counts failed")
        return f"<p>{render.PAGE_ERROR_SENTENCE}</p>", 503
```

(d) Replace the 404 handler:

```python
@app.exception_handler(StarletteHTTPException)
async def custom_exception_handler(request: Request, exc: StarletteHTTPException):
    """Serve the "Not in this edition" page for page routes; keep JSON for the API."""
    if exc.status_code == 404 and not request.url.path.startswith("/api"):
        from app.dependencies import get_data_service
        try:
            member_counts = get_data_service().get_member_counts()
        except Exception:
            # A data failure must not turn every 404 into a 500: the chips lose their counts.
            logger.exception("member counts unavailable for the 404 page")
            member_counts = {}
        content = render.render_not_found(
            render.render_zip_form(label="Find your representatives instead"),
            render.render_state_links(member_counts),
        )
        response = _serve_html("404.html", {
            "title": "Page Not Found — ClearVoting",
            "h1": "We don't have that page",
            "description": "The link may be old, or the bill or member may be outside our four-state coverage.",
            "url": f"{SITE_URL}{request.url.path}",
        }, content)
        response.status_code = 404
        return response
    return await http_exception_handler(request, exc)
```

```html
    <button type="button" class="btn btn--secondary" id="about-feedback-cta">Open the feedback form</button>
  </section>

  <section id="browser" aria-labelledby="browser-h">
    <h2 id="browser-h">What stays in your browser</h2>
    <p>We remember where you live, never how you look. Your state and district stay in your browser (<code>cv-home</code>) until you press Forget. Whether you revealed party labels is kept only for this browsing session in this tab. Showing them asks our server for the party field, so that request appears in our hosts' request logs like any page address.</p>
  </section>

  <section id="logs" aria-labelledby="logs-h">
    <h2 id="logs-h">Logs</h2>
    <p>The ZIP you type becomes part of the page address, so it appears in our hosts' request logs along with your IP address. We use those logs only for counts of page paths. Render keeps request logs for a limited period set by its plan; we keep no copy.</p>
  </section>

  <section id="processors" aria-labelledby="processors-h">
    <h2 id="processors-h">Who handles data for us</h2>
    <ul>
      <li>Google (Sheets): holds the notify and feedback sheets.</li>
      <li>Render (hosting): runs the server and keeps its request logs.</li>
      <li>Cloudflare (network): carries every request to our server.</li>
    </ul>
  </section>

  <section id="third-party" aria-labelledby="third-party-h">
    <h2 id="third-party-h">Requests to other sites</h2>
    <p>This site makes no third-party requests except member photos from congress.gov, which receives only our site's address as the referrer.</p>
    <p>No cookies, no analytics scripts.</p>
  </section>
</article>
```

```python
"""Copy rules that span files (spec §4.6, §4.7, §7.4, §7.6, §7.7, §12.3) — plan Task T5.1."""
import re
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

import pytest
from httpx import AsyncClient, ASGITransport

from app.main import app
from app.services.ai_summary import SYSTEM_PROMPT

ROOT = Path(__file__).parent.parent
FIXTURES = Path(__file__).parent / "fixtures" / "synced"
SHELLS = sorted((ROOT / "static").glob("*.html"))
JS_FILES = sorted((ROOT / "static" / "js").glob("*.js"))
EMAIL_RE = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@((?:[A-Za-z0-9-]+\.)+[A-Za-z]{2,})")
EXAMPLE_DOMAINS = {"example.com", "example.org"}   # input placeholders, not contact addresses
ASSET_SUFFIXES = {"png", "jpg", "jpeg", "gif", "svg", "webp", "css", "js"}   # "icon@2x.png" is not an address
BALLOT_PERSON_RE = re.compile(r"\b(On|Not on) the ballot")
PLACEHOLDER_RE = re.compile(r"\{[a-z_][a-z0-9_]*\}")


def _patch_data_dir():
    return patch("app.dependencies.get_data_dir", return_value=FIXTURES)


def _clear_data_service_cache():
    from app.dependencies import get_data_service
    get_data_service.cache_clear()


async def _get(path: str):
    with _patch_data_dir():
        _clear_data_service_cache()
        transport = ASGITransport(app=app)
        async with AsyncClient(transport=transport, base_url="http://test") as client:
            response = await client.get(path)
    _clear_data_service_cache()
    return response


class _ListItems(HTMLParser):
    """Text of each top-level <li> of the <ol> whose id is list_id."""

    def __init__(self, list_id: str):
        super().__init__()
        self.list_id = list_id
        self.depth = 0
        self.item = None
        self.items: list[str] = []

    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        if tag == "ol" and dict(attrs).get("id") == self.list_id:
            self.depth = 1
        elif self.depth and tag == "ol":
            self.depth += 1
        elif self.depth == 1 and tag == "li":
            self.item = ""

    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        if self.depth and tag == "ol":
            self.depth -= 1
        elif self.depth == 1 and tag == "li" and self.item is not None:
            self.items.append(self.item.strip())
            self.item = None

    def handle_data(self, data):
        if self.item is not None:
            self.item += data


def _list_items(html: str, list_id: str) -> list[str]:
    parser = _ListItems(list_id)
    parser.feed(html)
    return parser.items


def _prompt_list(heading: str) -> list[str]:
    """Parse the prompt independently of app.render.prompt_rules."""
    block = re.search(rf"^{heading}[^\n]*\n(.*?)\n\n", SYSTEM_PROMPT, re.S | re.M).group(1)
    return re.findall(r"^\d+\.\s+(.+)$", block, re.M)


def _emails(text: str) -> list[str]:
    return [
        m.group(0) for m in EMAIL_RE.finditer(text)
        if m.group(1).lower() not in EXAMPLE_DOMAINS
        and m.group(1).lower().rsplit(".", 1)[-1] not in ASSET_SUFFIXES
    ]


# --- The neutrality rules on /methodology equal the prompt ---

async def test_methodology_rule_lists_equal_the_prompt():
    html = (await _get("/methodology")).text
    neutrality = _prompt_list("STRICT RULES")
    accuracy = _prompt_list("ACCURACY RULES")
    assert neutrality and accuracy
    assert "Our rules for neutrality" in html
    assert _list_items(html, "neutrality-rules") == neutrality
    assert _list_items(html, "accuracy-rules") == accuracy
    assert not re.search(r"\b\d+ (strict )?rules\b", html, re.I), "no rule count in prose"


# --- No email address is published (§12.3 decision 1) ---

def test_no_email_address_in_shells_scripts_or_render_code():
    found = []
    for path in [*SHELLS, *JS_FILES, ROOT / "app" / "render.py"]:
        found += [f"{path.name}: {e}" for e in _emails(path.read_text())]
    assert found == []


@pytest.mark.parametrize("path", ["/about", "/methodology", "/privacy", "/no-such-page"])
async def test_trust_pages_publish_no_email_address(path):
    html = (await _get(path)).text
    assert "mailto:" not in html
    assert _emails(html) == []


# --- Ballot copy describes the seat, never the person (§7.4) ---

def test_ballot_copy_never_describes_the_person():
    files = [ROOT / "app" / "render.py", ROOT / "static" / "js" / "site.js", *SHELLS]
    hits = [
        f"{path.name}:{n}"
        for path in files if path.exists()
        for n, line in enumerate(path.read_text().splitlines(), 1)
        if BALLOT_PERSON_RE.search(line)
    ]
    assert hits == []


# --- No {placeholder} survives in shipped copy (§7.7) ---

@pytest.mark.parametrize("path", ["/", "/state?code=NY", "/about", "/methodology", "/privacy", "/no-such-page"])
async def test_no_placeholder_survives_in_rendered_copy(path):
    response = await _get(path)
    assert PLACEHOLDER_RE.findall(response.text) == []


# --- /privacy matches the code (§4.7) ---

def test_privacy_storage_claims_match_the_scripts():
    text = "\n".join(path.read_text() for path in JS_FILES)
    assert "document.cookie" not in text
    assert set(re.findall(r"""['"](cv-[a-z-]+)['"]""", text)) <= {"cv-home", "cv-show-party"}


def test_privacy_never_claims_the_reveal_stays_local():
    # The party reveal asks our server for ?show_party=true, so it is in the request logs (§4.7).
    if any("show_party=true" in path.read_text() for path in JS_FILES):
        assert "never sent to us" not in (ROOT / "static" / "privacy.html").read_text()


# Self-scoping checks: a legacy file is exempt only while it still carries its legacy marker,
# so each check passes at every commit and tightens by itself when T6.3 / T7.4 rewrite
# member.js / bill.js (the marker goes) and when T8.3 creates static/fonts/ (every shell and
# stylesheet is then checked). No later task has to remove a marker.
LEGACY_PARTY_MARKER = "let showParty = localStorage"


def test_party_reveal_is_never_persisted_in_local_storage():
    offenders = [
        f"{path.name}:{n}"
        for path in JS_FILES
        if LEGACY_PARTY_MARKER not in path.read_text()
        for n, line in enumerate(path.read_text().splitlines(), 1)
        if "localStorage" in line and "cv-show-party" in line and "removeItem" not in line
    ]
    assert offenders == []


def test_privacy_third_party_claim_holds_no_font_hosts():
    if not (ROOT / "static" / "fonts").is_dir():
        pytest.skip("fonts are self-hosted from T8.3; until then every shell loads Google Fonts")
    files = [*SHELLS, *sorted((ROOT / "static" / "css").glob("*.css"))]
    assert [p.name for p in files if re.search(r"fonts\.(googleapis|gstatic)\.com", p.read_text())] == []
```

```python
# --- Trust-page renderers (plan Task T5.1) ---
import pytest  # noqa: E402,F811
from app import render as _trust_render  # noqa: E402

_TRUST_HOSTILE = ["<script>alert(1)</script>", '"><img src=x>', "&amp;", "javascript:alert(1)"]


def _trust_outputs(s: str) -> dict[str, str]:
    counts = {"members": 150, "senators": 8, "bills": 1610, "shown": 1435, "missing": 60,
              "withheld": 115, "audited": 1200, "nominations": 1469,
              "since": s, "ai_summaries_updated": s}
    sources = {"name": s, "url": s, "retrieved": s, "licence": s, "share": s}
    senate = {"_source": {"url": s, "retrieved": s, "method": s}, "election_day": "2026-11-03",
              "seats": [{"state": "TX", "bioguideId": "C001056", "name": s, "kind": "regular", "class": 2}]}
    return {
        "render_about_counts": _trust_render.render_about_counts(counts),
        "render_methodology": _trust_render.render_methodology(
            counts, sources, {"neutrality": [s], "accuracy": [s]}, senate),
    }


@pytest.mark.parametrize("hostile", _TRUST_HOSTILE)
def test_trust_renderers_escape_hostile_input(hostile):

    for name, out in outputs.items():
        assert "<script>alert(1)</script>" not in out, name
        assert '"><img src=x>' not in out, name
        assert 'href="javascript:' not in out, name
    if hostile == "&amp;":
        assert "&amp;amp;" in outputs["render_methodology"]
```

  - `render.result_phrase(rc: dict, chamber: str) -> str` — `rc` is one `votes_index.json` `roll_calls` entry, `chamber` "House"/"Senate" → "Passed the Senate 90–6" (§7.2) (T1.2).
  - `render.position_chip(vote: str | None) -> dict` — `{"text", "variant", "short"}` from the one §7.1 positions table (`render._POSITIONS`, lower-case keys `yea aye nay no "not voting" present "present, giving live pair" guilty "not guilty"`; any other string → "Voted"/`other`), twinned by site.js `chip()`; and `render._MONTHS_LONG` (the locale-free month names `format_date` uses) (T1.2). This task never keeps its own copy of either table (§7.1: one table shared by the Python and JS formatters).
  - `render.render_seal(text: str, variant: str) -> str` — `<span class="seal seal--{variant}">{h(text)}</span>`; variants `final moving pending ballot` (T3.2).
  - `DataService.get_member_page(bioguide_id: str, page: int = 1, topic: str | None = None, position: str | None = None, plain: bool = False) -> dict | None` (T1.7). This task reads exactly these keys:
    ```text
    {
      "member": {"bioguideId", "name", "state", "stateCode", "district", "chamber",
                 "terms", "depiction"},            # members.json row; renderers never read party keys
      "seat": "regular" | "special" | None,         # DataService.seat_up_2026(member)
      "has_record": bool,                           # False when member_votes/{id}.json is missing
      "stats": {"total_votes", "yea_count", "nay_count", "not_voting_count"} | None,
      "first_vote_date": "2021-01-06" | None,       # earliest member_votes date (ISO)
      "last_vote_date": "2026-08-08" | None,
      "nominations_count": int | None,              # senators only (index PN roll calls since first vote)
      "recent_votes": [RecentVote, ...],            # <= 8, newest first (§4.3 m2 rule)
      "record": {...},                              # read by T6.2
      "sponsored": [Sponsored, ...],                # get_bills_by_sponsor rows, newest first
      "sponsored_count": int,
      "donation": dict | None,                      # donations.json entry
    }
    RecentVote = {"rc": "senate/119_2_00228", "roll_call": <votes_index roll_calls entry>,
                  "chamber": "Senate", "bill_id": "119-hr-6500", "congress": 119,
                  "bill_type": "hr", "bill_number": 6500, "one_liner": str,
                  "position": "yes" | "no", "date": "2026-08-08T03:37:00", "policy_area": str}
    Sponsored  = {"congress": 119, "type": "S", "number": "3385", "title": str,
                  "introduced_date": "2025-12-08",
                  "one_liner": str | None,          # set only when the summary is displayable
                  "status": {"text": "Passed the Senate 68–32", "variant": "final" | "moving"}}
    ```
  - `site.css` classes (T2.1): `.kicker .seal .seal--pending .seal--ballot .chip .chip--yes .chip--no .chip--nv .chip--present .chip--other .vote-row .photo .bill-row .btn--secondary .party-toggle .party`.
- Produces (all in `app/render.py`):
  - `render_vote_row(href: str | None, chip_html: str, headline: str, displayable: bool, meta_parts: list[str], extra_html: str = "") -> str` — the shared `.vote-row` (§6.4).
  - `render_member_header(page: dict) -> str` — breadcrumb `nav.crumb` + `header.member-header` (h1, fact line, seat seal, action row).
  - `render_recent_votes(rows: list[dict]) -> str` — `section#recent` or `""`.
  - `render_sponsored(bills: list[dict], name: str, bioguide: str, total: int | None = None) -> str` — `section#sponsored`.
  - `render_money(donation: dict | None) -> str` — `section.member-money`.
  - Private helpers used again by T6.2: `_mp_join`, `_mp_iso_day`, `_mp_month_year`, `_mp_short_date`, `_mp_chip`, `_mp_bill_href`, `_mp_source_url`, `_mp_source_anchor`, `_mp_is_speaker`, `_mp_phrase`, constants `_MP_KNOWN_POSITIONS`, `_MP_PENDING`.
- Not built here: the desktop fact strip (T10.5, cut-first).

**Resolves:** spec §4.3 fold, §4.3 m1 (header), m2 (recent votes), m5 (sponsored), m7 (campaign money), §6.4 vote row, §6.3 photos, §7.4 ballot copy (seat, never person), §7.5, §2.5 B; findings F07, F08, F29, F56, F36, F26.
